about_tmdb_attribution: This application uses TMDB and the TMDB APIs but is not endorsed, certified, or otherwise approved by TMDB.
adaptation_progress_empty: No mappings yet. Note “episode N ≈ volume M” to estimate where the original is.
adaptation_progress_estimate: Watched up to episode ${episode} ≈ ${position} of the original
adaptation_progress_infer_unavailable: Automatic inference from subtitles and the original text is not available yet.
ai_agent_attach_screen_image: Attach a screenshot and screen text
ai_agent_history_empty: The AI assistant hasn't changed anything yet.
ai_agent_history_summary: Everything the AI assistant changed; undo any of it
ai_agent_input_hint: Tell the assistant what to do…
ai_agent_no_provider: The AI assistant has no provider yet. Assign one in Settings › Models › LLM.
ai_agent_peer_access: Let paired devices use the AI assistant
ai_agent_peer_access_hint: When this device is the interconnect host, paired devices can run AI assistant sessions here: they use this device's AI provider and can change this device's library and settings (every change can be undone in AI operation history). Off by default.
ai_agent_remote_lost: Lost the connection to the device running this conversation.
ai_agent_remote_no_provider: $device has no AI provider assigned to the AI assistant. Assign one in Settings › Models › LLM on that device.
ai_agent_remote_not_ready: $device isn't ready yet. Try again in a moment.
ai_agent_remote_unreachable: Can't reach $device, the download execution device.
ai_agent_remote_unsupported: $device can't run the AI assistant. Update Fushi on that device.
ai_agent_screen_text_edit_hint: Fix any misrecognized characters before sending. Clear it to leave the text out.
ai_agent_screen_text_empty: No text found on the screen
ai_agent_screen_text_unavailable: Text recognition isn't available on this device
ai_agent_session_delete_message: “${title}” will be removed from this device. Changes the assistant made stay in the AI action log and can still be undone there.
ai_agent_sessions_retention_hint: Conversations stay on this device for 30 days
ai_agent_stop_repeated_failure: Stopped: the same step failed twice.
ai_agent_stop_token_budget: Stopped: this conversation used up its token budget.
ai_agent_stop_tool_limit: Stopped: too many steps in one turn.
ai_agent_superseded: Changed again afterwards; left as is
ai_agent_usage_breakdown: Input ${input} · Output ${output} · Cache read ${cacheRead} · Cache write ${cacheWrite}
ai_assist_empty: AI did not return a usable result. Try describing it differently.
ai_assist_no_provider: Choose an AI provider for this feature under Settings and AI first
ai_error_not_configured: This provider is not fully configured
ai_error_unsupported_protocol: This provider's protocol has no transcription endpoint (use an OpenAI-compatible provider)
ai_feature_acquire_summary: Tell AI what you want — videos, or books, manga and games in Browse › Discover. It parses the request and picks matching works and versions; videos are then downloaded or subscribed, other media need your confirmation for each download.
ai_feature_agent_summary: Ask in one sentence and the assistant does it in the app; every change can be undone
ai_feature_audiobook_cast_summary: Mark which character speaks each line so different voices can read them
ai_feature_cloud_transcription_summary: Transcribes audio with an OpenAI-compatible Whisper endpoint (e.g. Groq). Set this provider's model to a Whisper model such as whisper-large-v3. Audio is uploaded to this provider and billed by it, only when you pick Cloud in the transcribe sheet. Does not follow the default provider.
ai_feature_collection_order_summary: When numbering rules can't place specials, OVAs or volumes, let AI decide where they go in a collection
ai_feature_custom_theme_summary: Let AI pick theme colors from a description
ai_feature_default_provider_summary: Every feature below uses this provider unless you pick another one for it
ai_feature_dict_style_summary: Let AI generate popup style rules and CSS from a description
ai_feature_galgame_text_process_summary: Let AI write cleanup rules for hooked game text
ai_feature_lapis_style_summary: Let AI generate Lapis card style rules and CSS from a description
ai_feature_library_organize_summary: Let AI put books, videos and games that belong together into collections
ai_feature_manga_ocr_summary: A vision model re-reads the text inside manga text boxes. Off until you pick a mode in Manga OCR settings; cropped text boxes are uploaded to this provider and billed by it.
ai_feature_media_links_summary: Let AI judge whether items from different modules are the same work
ai_feature_overrides_none: All features use the default provider
ai_feature_srs_note_field_summary: Let AI write definitions, translations or rewrites for a note field (draft only until you save)
ai_feature_srs_template_summary: Let AI lay out review cards from a description and explain fields
ai_feature_subtitle_proofread_summary: Fixes speech-recognition Japanese subtitles: builds a name list for the work, then corrects misheard lines. Also used by AI proofread in the transcribe sheet (fixes words and punctuation; lines and timing unchanged). Only the recognized text and the name list are sent to this provider (no audio or video) and billed by it.
ai_feature_video_identify_assist_summary: When scraping finds several candidates or nothing at all, let AI pick the matching work or suggest titles to search
ai_feature_video_search_subtitle_summary: Let AI re-rank subtitle results when subtitles are filled in automatically in the background
ai_features_section_summary: Pick a default provider, then override it only for the features that need a different one or no AI
ai_interconnect_host_hint: AI video downloads hand the whole conversation to this device over Fushi Interconnect: it uses that device's AI assignment and download setup. Same setting as Downloads › Execution device.
ai_interconnect_host_unpaired: No paired device yet. Pair a computer in Fushi Interconnect to let it handle AI video downloads with its own AI.
ai_mcp_access_hint: Lets MCP clients on this computer (Claude Desktop, Claude Code…) call Fushi's operations. Listens on this computer only and needs the pairing token below. Changes that can be undone run directly and show up in the AI action log; anything that can't be undone, and installing extensions, asks you here first. Off by default.
ai_mcp_confirm_expire: Declined automatically if you do not answer within ${minutes} minutes.
ai_mcp_token_hint: Generate a token for your MCP client. Generating a new one revokes the old one.
ai_mcp_token_issued_body: Put this token in your MCP client's configuration as FUSHI_MCP_TOKEN (the setup guide shows how). It is shown only once.
ai_media_acquire_ai_failed: AI is unavailable right now; results are from your original text, sorted by seeders.
ai_media_acquire_hint: Tell AI what to download, e.g. a title plus any version you want
ai_media_acquire_no_results: Nothing found. Try another title, or check that sources are enabled.
ai_media_acquire_picking: AI is picking the best matches…
ai_provider_accepts_images_summary: Turn on for vision models. The AI assistant then sends a screenshot along with the screen text.
ai_provider_allow_http_summary: Required for local servers on http://localhost
ai_provider_api_keys_summary: With several keys, a request that is rejected, rate-limited or out of credit switches to the next key and retries; the failing key cools down and is tried again later.
ai_provider_base_url_invalid: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS endpoint
ai_provider_model_hint: Leave empty, then fetch the list
ai_provider_pricing_summary: Copy this model's prices from the provider's price list to see what each AI assistant conversation costs. Leave them empty to show tokens only; empty cache prices count at the input price.
ai_provider_rate_limit_hint: Empty = no limit. Use your plan's limit so requests aren't rejected for going too fast.
ai_providers_section_summary: Add providers Fushi can call. Built-in presets, plus any Chat Completions compatible API.
ai_settings_summary: Configure AI providers and choose which one powers each feature
ai_video_acquire_ai_picked: Picked: $title (AI, $confidence). Tap a candidate below to change.
ai_video_acquire_ai_unavailable: AI is unavailable ($reason); please pick with the buttons.
ai_video_acquire_airing_unknown: I could not tell whether it is still airing, so subscribing stays available.
ai_video_acquire_already_in_library_epis: $title is already in your library (up to episode $episode).
ai_video_acquire_ask_franchise_fallback: No other matching works were found. Download only “$title”?
ai_video_acquire_ask_mode: It is still airing. Download what is out now, or subscribe for new episodes?
ai_video_acquire_ask_resolution_fallback: No $wanted release. Take one of these instead?
ai_video_acquire_ask_subscribe_fallback: No release has enough version evidence to subscribe. Download now instead?
ai_video_acquire_ask_subtitle_language: Which subtitle language? (asked once; change it later in settings)
ai_video_acquire_entry: Ask AI to download a work
ai_video_acquire_failure_no_candidates: No releases found for this work.
ai_video_acquire_failure_no_plannable_ve: Releases were found, but none covers what you asked for.
ai_video_acquire_failure_no_sources: There is no managed video source to download into.
ai_video_acquire_failure_remote_unavaila: Lost connection to the device running this conversation. Check that it's online and try again.
ai_video_acquire_franchise_found: Found “$name”: $series TV series and $movies movies. Searching releases one by one…
ai_video_acquire_franchise_not_found: No other works found in the series of “$title”, continuing with this one.
ai_video_acquire_franchise_progress: Still looking up “$name”: $series TV series and $movies movies found so far…
ai_video_acquire_franchise_ready: $ready of $total works have releases. Untick what you don't want, then submit. Series still airing will be subscribed.
ai_video_acquire_franchise_searching: Looking for every work in the series of “$title” (checking each work, this can take a minute)…
ai_video_acquire_franchise_submitted: Queued $downloads downloads and added $subscriptions subscriptions. Failed: $failed.
ai_video_acquire_franchise_truncated: Couldn’t look up every related work of “$name” — the list below may be missing some.
ai_video_acquire_franchise_unavailable: Couldn’t get the full series list for “$title” (the metadata source failed or is unavailable).
ai_video_acquire_greeting: Which work do you want? I will find it, pick a release and download or subscribe for you.
ai_video_acquire_input_hint: Tell me which work to download, e.g. "SPY×FAMILY season 2"
ai_video_acquire_recommend_criteria_curr: By what you asked for, the current one (version $index) fits best.
ai_video_acquire_recommend_criteria_swit: By what you asked for, version $index fits best. Switched to it.
ai_video_acquire_recommend_preference_cu: Ranked by your quality, source and bitrate preferences and then search relevance, the current one (version $index) is the top pick.
ai_video_acquire_recommend_preference_sw: Ranked by your quality, source and bitrate preferences and then search relevance, version $index is the top pick. Switched to it.
ai_video_acquire_remember_default: Use as default from now on
ai_video_acquire_remote_no_provider: $device has no AI provider assigned to AI download. Assign one in Settings › Models › LLM on that device.
ai_video_acquire_remote_not_ready: $device isn't ready to download yet (download backend or managed video source not set up).
ai_video_acquire_remote_unsupported: $device doesn't support AI video download. Update Fushi on that device.
ai_video_acquire_submitted_download: Queued $count download(s). See the downloads page for progress.
ai_video_acquire_submitted_subscribe: Subscribed. New episodes will download automatically.
ai_video_acquire_subtitle_remembered: Subtitle language $language is saved as this work's preference.
ai_video_acquire_subtitle_unresolved: I could not tell this work's language. Which subtitle language do you want?
ai_video_acquire_unclear: I did not get that. Pick an option or say it differently.
ai_video_acquire_work_alias_resolved: No direct match for $query. Looked it up: searching as $titles.
ai_video_acquire_work_not_found: I could not find "$query". Try another name?
ai_video_download_bitrate_hint: Estimated from the size per episode; ranks versions that already match the quality and source.
ai_video_download_quality_hint: Used when the AI download assistant picks a release; "Best available" takes the highest resolution found, "Ask each time" asks on every request.
ai_video_download_skip_extras_hint: PV, CM, NCOP/NCED, menus and similar. Applies to every download into a video source: extras inside a torrent are not downloaded, and extras-only releases are never picked.
ai_video_download_source_best: Best (Remux > Blu-ray > WEB-DL > WEBRip > TV > DVD)
ai_video_download_source_hint: Versions from this source are tried first; others are still used when it is missing. Blu-ray includes BDRip and Remux.
ai_video_download_subtitle_language_hint: Subtitles are always fetched; this decides which language. "Follow the work" uses the work's own language.
ai_web_knowledge_custom_endpoint_invalid: Enter an https:// address ending in api.php
ai_web_knowledge_custom_name_hint: Leave empty to use the host name
ai_web_knowledge_section_hint: Fushi itself fetches article text or work lists from the selected sources and hands them to the AI (used when AI video download lists the works of a franchise and when identifying video works). Your AI provider does not need web access. The AI can only cite what was fetched, and every listed work is still checked against the metadata source one by one. Other MediaWiki sites (such as a franchise wiki on Fandom) can be added below.
anime_download_no_results_detail: The service responded successfully but returned 0 items. Query: $query; filters: $filters. Try another title or loosen the filters.
anime_download_play_now_fail: Not ready yet (metadata pending or connection failed) — try again later
anime_download_play_now_ok: Imported — open it from the video library to play while downloading
anime_download_pushed: Pushed — it will be imported automatically once finished
anime_download_relocate_hint: Fushi renames/moves through the download engine, so seeding is not interrupted. Renaming in Explorer can never be recovered.
anime_download_relocate_library_failed: Files moved, but the library still points at the old path: $reason
anime_download_relocate_no_files: This task has no files to rename yet (metadata not ready)
anime_download_search_error_proxy_hint: If the site cannot be reached directly, configure a network proxy in download settings.
anime_download_search_failed: Search failed or timed out. Tap retry.
anime_download_search_start_hint: Search a title above - torrents and subtitles are matched automatically. Downloads are not limited to video: books, manga, audiobooks and games are imported too.
anime_download_subs_deferred: Subtitles are matched after download, from the pack's actual files
anime_download_subs_episodes_unverified: Episode numbers are not verified against this pack - subtitles may come from another season.
anime_download_subs_need_key: Enter a Jimaku API key above to search subtitles.
anime_download_subs_retrying: Subtitles: not up yet — will retry automatically
anime_download_subs_season_mismatch: No subtitle entry matches season $season of this pack - not auto-selected. Pick one manually if you want it anyway.
anime_download_subs_unmatched: Subtitles: no match for this pack
anki_allow_duplicates_hint: Skip duplicate check when adding cards
anki_ankimobile_opened: AnkiMobile opened. Approve the request there, then return to Fushi.
anki_backup_import: Import Anki backup for duplicate check
anki_backup_import_done: Imported $count words from the Anki backup
anki_backup_import_failed: Could not read this Anki backup
anki_backup_import_hint: $count words imported. Export a .colpkg or .apkg backup from AnkiMobile and import it here so lookups recognize cards already in Anki. Re-import now and then to stay current.
anki_batch_mining_hint: Save cards on this device first and send them to Anki together later, instead of one at a time.
anki_card_action_failed: Card action failed. Please try again.
anki_compact_glossaries_hint: Use compact format for glossary entries
anki_connect_addon_anki_not_running: No running Anki found. Start Anki desktop first, then try again.
anki_connect_addon_download_failed: Could not download AnkiConnect from AnkiWeb: $error
anki_connect_addon_handed: Handed AnkiConnect to Anki. Confirm the prompt in Anki, then restart Anki as it advises.
anki_connect_addon_install_hint: Downloads AnkiConnect from AnkiWeb and hands it to the running Anki. Anki will ask you to confirm, then advise a restart.
anki_connect_addon_invalid: AnkiWeb returned something that is not a usable add-on package.
anki_connect_addon_launch_failed: Could not hand the add-on to Anki: $error
anki_connect_api_key_hint: Required for remote AnkiConnect; must match the key configured in the add-on
anki_connect_mobile_api_key_required: Configure a matching AnkiConnect API key before switching to the AnkiConnect backend.
anki_connect_mobile_disabled_key_cleared: AnkiConnect needs an API key on mobile, so clearing it turned the switch back off. Anki now goes through the built-in backend again.
anki_connect_port_auto_fix_done: Switched AnkiConnect to port ${port}. Restart Anki to apply.
anki_connect_port_auto_fix_hint: Picks a free port and writes it to both Fushi and the AnkiConnect add-on config. Restart Anki to apply.
anki_connect_port_auto_fix_manual: Fushi now uses port ${port}, but the AnkiConnect add-on config was not found. Set webBindPort to ${port} in Anki (Tools -> Add-ons -> AnkiConnect -> Config), then restart Anki.
anki_connect_port_auto_fix_none: No free port found on this machine.
anki_connect_use_on_mobile_hint: Use only on a trusted network. AnkiConnect uses cleartext HTTP; configure a matching API key, then refresh decks and note types after switching.
anki_create_lapis_exists: Lapis note type and deck already exist — selected them.
anki_create_lapis_hint: Adds the Lapis note type and a Lapis deck to Anki, then selects them as the mining target.
anki_create_lapis_not_found: Anki said the Lapis deck and note type were created, but they are still missing when Fushi reads the collection back. Open Anki, make sure it is not busy, and try again.
anki_create_lapis_success: Lapis note type and deck created.
anki_dedup_auto_delete_hint: Skips the confirmation dialog. Only byte-identical extra copies are ever removed and nothing is re-encoded, but deletion cannot be undone.
anki_dedup_auto_done: Removed $count duplicate Anki media files, $size reclaimed
anki_dedup_auto_found: Found $count duplicate Anki media files ($size reclaimable)
anki_dedup_auto_hint: Off by default. When on, Fushi scans at startup (at most once a week) and shows you the list first — nothing is deleted until you confirm.
anki_dedup_cancelled: Deduplication cancelled; completed changes are kept.
anki_dedup_plan_busy_note: Anki may be unresponsive while this runs; avoid using Anki until it finishes.
anki_dedup_plan_intro: $count extra copies, $size reclaimable. One copy of each file is kept and every reference is repointed to it first; nothing is ever re-encoded.
anki_dedup_plan_journal: A journal of every rewrite and deletion is written to the backup folder first.
anki_dedup_progress_indexing: Reading notes to find media references… ($done / $total)
anki_dedup_report_body: $groups duplicate groups; $removed extra copies ($size); $notes notes and $models note types rewritten; $skipped skipped.
anki_dedup_report_cancelled_note: Cancelled early — the numbers below only cover what was completed.
anki_dedup_run_hint: Scans first and lists exactly what would be deleted; nothing is removed until you confirm.
anki_dedup_unavailable: Requires Anki running on this machine (AnkiConnect).
anki_desktop_auto_launch_hint: If AnkiConnect on this computer isn't responding when Fushi starts, open Anki desktop automatically.
anki_desktop_executable_detect_failed: Couldn't detect it. Newer Anki versions run through a launcher; choose the program manually.
anki_desktop_executable_unset_default: Not set. The system's default Anki will be used.
anki_desktop_executable_unset_required: Not set. Choose Anki's program, or open Anki and tap Detect.
anki_duplicate_scope_hint: Which decks are searched when checking whether a card already exists. AnkiConnect only; AnkiDroid always searches the whole collection.
anki_error_all_fields_empty: Every field of this card came out empty — usually the selected note type has no field mappings yet. Map its fields in Anki settings.
anki_error_ankidroid_unavailable: AnkiDroid is not installed (or its API is disabled), so card access cannot be granted. Install AnkiDroid and enable its API, or switch to AnkiConnect.
anki_error_ankimobile_no_decks: AnkiMobile returned no decks or note types.
anki_error_ankimobile_not_active: Fushi did not come back to the foreground in time, so the clipboard could not be read. Return to Fushi and try again.
anki_error_ankimobile_pasteboard_denied: iOS blocked reading the clipboard. Choose Allow Paste when returning to Fushi, then try again.
anki_error_ankimobile_pasteboard_empty: AnkiMobile did not return any configuration. Approve the request in AnkiMobile, then come back to Fushi.
anki_error_ankimobile_unavailable: Could not open AnkiMobile. Install AnkiMobile and try again.
anki_error_collection_unavailable: AnkiDroid's collection is currently unavailable. Open AnkiDroid at least once, make sure it isn't syncing and the API is enabled, then retry.
anki_error_connection_refused: Could not connect to Anki: connection refused. Make sure Anki Desktop is running and the AnkiConnect add-on is installed.
anki_error_connection_timeout: Could not connect to Anki: the connection timed out. Check the host, port, and firewall settings.
anki_error_connection_unknown: Could not export to Anki: an unexpected connection error occurred. See the error log for details.
anki_error_field_mapping_mismatch: None of your field mappings match the selected note type, so Anki rejected the card. Open Anki settings to re-map the fields, or use 'Create Lapis deck'.
anki_error_first_field_empty: The first field of the selected note type is empty, and Anki refuses such a note. Map a field to it in Anki settings.
anki_error_http: Could not export to Anki: an HTTP error occurred while contacting AnkiConnect.
anki_error_paired_device_unreachable: Couldn't create the card because the Fushi Interconnect server could not be reached. Make sure Fushi is running there, or turn off Mine to Fushi Interconnect server in Anki settings to create cards locally.
anki_error_permission_denied: AnkiDroid hasn't granted card access permission. Approve the system permission dialog that just appeared, then tap the button again to export.
anki_error_permission_permanently_denied: AnkiDroid card access was permanently denied, so the system no longer shows the permission dialog. Open app settings and grant the AnkiDroid permission, then try again.
anki_error_sync_signed_out: Sign in to your Anki sync server first (Anki settings › Anki sync).
anki_error_sync_unavailable: This device doesn't have fushi-anki-sync, so it can't sync to Anki directly.
anki_lapis_apply_done: Lapis style applied. A backup was saved first.
anki_lapis_backup_done_pruned: Backed up to $path ($count old backups pruned by the 90-day / keep-10 policy)
anki_lapis_custom_css_hint: Appended to the Lapis stylesheet in a protected user section.
anki_lapis_font_scale_hint: Scales every Lapis font size; takes effect via "Apply style to Anki".
anki_lapis_foreign_edit_body: The Lapis template in Anki differs from what Fushi last applied - it may have been edited by hand. Applying will overwrite it; a backup is saved first. Continue?
anki_lapis_not_found: Lapis note type not found in Anki.
anki_lapis_restore_confirm: Overwrite the Lapis template in Anki with this backup? The current state is backed up first.
anki_lapis_restore_factory_confirm: This overwrites the Lapis styling and card templates in Anki with Fushi's bundled version, and resets font size, custom CSS and custom areas. A backup of the current state is saved first. Card data is not touched.
anki_lapis_restore_factory_hint: Overwrite the Lapis note type in Anki with the version bundled in Fushi and clear every customisation here.
anki_lapis_suggest_body: The selected deck and note type can't produce a card Anki will accept. Fushi can add its Lapis note type and deck and select them for you.
anki_lapis_up_to_date: Lapis style is already up to date.
anki_lapis_visual_block_needs_note_type: Pick a note type first to choose fields.
anki_lapis_visual_blocks_hint: Show existing fields somewhere else on the card. Display only: no Anki field is added or deleted.
anki_lapis_visual_editor_hint: Preview the Lapis card, then change each area's style, position and field mapping without writing CSS.
anki_lapis_visual_field_definition_info_: Only visible on cards that keep more than one definition block; single-definition cards hide it.
anki_lapis_visual_field_dictionary_name_: On Fushi cards this label also carries the part-of-speech tags, so the two cannot be styled separately.
anki_lapis_visual_layout_hint: Uses Lapis' own layout switches, so desktop and mobile Anki both follow it.
anki_lapis_visual_mapping_hint: Anki fields that fill the selected area. Changes are saved together with the style.
anki_lapis_visual_mapping_none: This area is drawn by the template itself and has no field of its own.
anki_lapis_visual_select_field_hint: Click any part of the preview, or pick one below. What you pick is what the controls underneath edit.
anki_mine_to_server_hint: Send mined cards to the Fushi Interconnect server's Anki (its decks and settings) instead of this device. Requires an interconnect pairing. If the server is offline, cards wait on this device and are sent once it's back.
anki_mined_card_subtitle: Choose what to do with the matching card.
anki_mined_unverified_subtitle: Fushi cannot read your AnkiMobile collection, so the mined mark comes from this device's own record — it cannot tell whether the card is still in Anki.
anki_not_configured: Tap Refresh to load your Anki decks and note types.
anki_note_open_failed: Could not open the card in Anki.
anki_note_open_failed_review: Could not open the card in Fushi review.
anki_note_viewer_empty: This card has no readable fields.
anki_open_no_card: No card found for this word in Anki.
anki_overwrite_scope_hint: Which already-made cards the green ✓ can overwrite
anki_pending_mine_landing_hint: Cards mined on devices without Anki are passed to this device through sync (such as Google Drive or WebDAV) and added to Anki here. Only one device receives them at a time.
anki_pending_mine_landing_host_note: This device is an interconnect host, so paired devices don't need this. Turn on "Mine to Fushi Interconnect server" on those devices and their cards go straight to Anki here.
anki_pending_mine_queued: Saved to pending cards. It will be sent to Anki later.
anki_pending_mines_ankimobile_hint: Each card opens AnkiMobile briefly. Fushi sends the next one when you come back, then asks AnkiMobile to sync.
anki_pending_mines_delete_confirm: Delete this pending card? It has not been sent to Anki yet.
anki_pending_mines_hint: Cards saved while Anki was unreachable or while batch mining was on
anki_pending_mines_stopped: $reason The remaining cards stay in the queue.
anki_pending_mines_unreachable: Anki can't be reached right now. The remaining cards stay in the queue.
anki_queue_undelivered_mines_hint: When Anki can't be reached, save the card to Pending cards and send it later instead of reporting a failure
anki_queue_undelivered_mines_title: Hold cards when Anki is unreachable
anki_refresh_hint: After creating or renaming a deck or note type in Anki, tap here to refresh.
anki_reposition_auto_hint: Reposition new cards by frequency about 30 seconds after the last card is mined.
anki_reposition_dicts_hint: Hidden frequency dictionaries are not loaded; unhide them in dictionary management first. Nothing selected means all loaded dictionaries.
anki_reposition_done_skipped: Repositioned $count new cards; $skipped were skipped because they are no longer new.
anki_reposition_empty: This deck has no new cards.
anki_reposition_gather_order_hint: If the deck's options use random new card order, positions are ignored. Set the new card gather/sort order to sequential.
anki_reposition_hint: Rewrites the learning order of a deck's new cards so common words come first. Review cards are never touched.
anki_reposition_include_subdecks_hint: Includes subdecks; cards in filtered decks are skipped.
anki_reposition_source_field_hint: Reads the field mapped to {frequency-harmonic-rank} (FreqSort in Lapis); no dictionary lookup.
anki_reposition_summary: $total new cards: $ranked with frequency, $unranked without (kept at the end). $changed positions will change.
anki_reposition_unchanged: Cards are already in this order.
anki_reposition_undo_done: Restored $count cards to their previous positions ($skipped skipped).
anki_reposition_undo_hint: Restores the positions saved before the last reorder ($time). Cards studied since then are left alone.
anki_sync_client_ankiweb_body: AnkiWeb's terms only allow the official Anki apps to sync. Fushi identifies itself honestly as Fushi, so AnkiWeb may refuse it or take action on your account. Self-hosted sync servers have no such restriction.
anki_sync_client_discard_confirm: $count card(s) haven't synced to Anki yet. Discard them and sign out? They can't be recovered.
anki_sync_client_enable_warn_body: Don't enable this unless you know what you're doing. Syncing to AnkiWeb is not allowed for third-party clients and may fail or put your account at risk.
anki_sync_client_error_not_sync_server: The server did not answer with the Anki sync protocol (the anki-original-size response header is missing). Make sure the address points at an Anki sync server (the official anki-sync-server, or the one built into Anki desktop) rather than a web page; a reverse proxy must keep this header. Details: $detail
anki_sync_client_has_unsynced: $count card(s) haven't synced yet. Sync them before switching account or signing out.
anki_sync_client_server_hint: Self-hosted server, e.g. http://nas:8080/ — leave empty for AnkiWeb
anki_sync_client_status_blocked: The server wants a full upload, which Fushi never does. Sync once in the official Anki app, then try again. Your cards stay here until then.
anki_sync_client_status_failing: $count card(s) couldn't be written to the collection and will be retried: $error
anki_sync_client_status_rate_limit_expir: The sync server rate-limited the last sync. The wait ended at $time; the next sync will try again.
anki_sync_client_status_rate_limited: The sync server is limiting requests (too many requests). Fushi will retry automatically after $time; your cards stay here until then.
anki_sync_client_use_hint: Fushi keeps its own copy of your collection and syncs it with your Anki sync server, so this device needs neither Anki nor AnkiConnect.
anki_tag_include_category_hint: Books get "book", videos get "video", games get "game", music gets "music"
anki_tag_include_fushi_hint: Mark every card mined by Fushi
anki_tags_global_hint: Added to every card, whichever profile is active.
anki_tags_hint: Space-separated tags added to every card
anki_tags_profile_hint: Only for cards mined in this profile. Switching profiles switches these tags.
anki_video_template_applied: Adaptation saved. Test a real video card on your review devices.
anki_video_template_audio_required: Use exactly one sentence audio mapping in another field, with its token appearing only once.
anki_video_template_autoplay: Autoplay embedded WebM (MP4 follows Anki playback settings)
anki_video_template_fallback_body: The note type $noteType can't play synchronized video clips, so this card used GIF + audio instead. Adapt the template to create video cards.
anki_video_template_fallback_title: Note type not adapted for video
anki_video_template_format_hint: WebM plays inside the card. MP4 uses the Anki native player. Check playback on each device after syncing.
anki_video_template_media_hint: Select a video clip in media settings to create new video cards.
anki_video_template_needed_hint: This note type isn't adapted for video; GIF + audio will be used instead. Tap to adapt.
anki_video_template_placement_hint: Kiku uses its original picture position. Other templates fall back to the bottom when the picture position cannot be located.
anki_video_template_preview_hint: Static sample of the first card back. Scripts, media and collection resources are not loaded; Kiku and other scripted layouts may be incomplete. This does not verify playback. Test a real card before relying on it.
anki_video_template_restore_hint: Restoring disables this player. Existing adapted WebM cards will temporarily lose video display and playback, but their media is kept. Enable adaptation again to restore playback.
anki_video_template_scope_hint: This changes every deck using this note type. A backup is saved before applying; Restore reverts the template. Missing media in old cards still needs to be mined again.
anki_video_template_unsupported: The note type could not be read or this connection cannot edit templates. Connect to desktop Anki or configure this on the target Android device.
app_ui_scale_hint: Scales the whole interface — text, icons and controls together — from 30% to 300%. Increase it if the UI looks small on large screens.
asr_models_delete_confirm_message: Transcription in this language will need the model downloaded again.
asr_models_section_summary: On-device speech recognition models. Download only the languages you need.
audio_clip_failed: Couldn't extract the audio clip — the audio source may be missing or unreadable
audio_source_connection_refused: Audio source refused the connection: nothing is listening at "${host}" — make sure the service is running, or remove this source in settings
audio_source_dns_error: Audio source connection failed: cannot resolve "${host}" — check your network, or remove this source in settings
audio_source_edit_target_gone: That audio source no longer exists — edit discarded
audio_source_loopback_warning: Points at this device — re-point after switching machines
audio_source_timeout: Audio source timeout: "${host}" — server not responding, try again later or change source
audio_source_unrecognized_response: Audio source "${host}" returned neither audio nor a Yomitan audio source list — check the link, or whether the service is the right type
audio_source_url_invalid: Link must be http(s) and contain a term or reading placeholder
audiobook_auto_transcribe_hint: Audiobooks downloaded without subtitles are transcribed on this device and added to the library (aligned to the book text if it came with one, otherwise as a subtitle book). Takes a while; the speech model is downloaded automatically if missing.
audiobook_background_play_hint: When off, audiobook playback stops when you leave the reader. Turn on to keep playing in the background.
audiobook_delete_confirm: Delete the attached audiobook? Its audio files are removed from this device.
audiobook_export_clip_no_selection: Select text first to export a clip
audiobook_export_clip_no_text: This selection has no text to render
audiobook_export_clip_share_unavailable: Clip saved, but the share sheet didn't open
audiobook_export_clip_too_long: Selection audio is too long to export (limit: 5 minutes)
audiobook_export_clip_unsupported_range: This selection can't be exported (crosses chapter or audio file)
audiobook_highlight_background_hint: Turn off to mark the sentence being read by text color only
audiobook_highlight_text_color_hint: Recolor the sentence being read. When off, it keeps the book text color, or uses the highlight color if the background is off
audiobook_jump_threshold_hint: Audio jumps at least this far (dragging the progress bar, tapping a sentence, chapter jumps) offer a return-to-position pill
audiobook_material_library_hint: Folders of subtitle and text files named by work id. Downloads are paired against them automatically.
audiobook_reference_original_desc: Keep audio where it is and play from its original path; the book breaks if the file is moved or deleted.
audiobook_rematch_all_zero: All windows scored 0%, please adjust manually
audiobook_rematch_no_sections: No chapter text found, cannot auto-match
audiobook_rematch_threshold_hint: Minimum similarity for fuzzy matching (Dice coefficient). Lower to tolerate more text differences, but too low causes false matches.
audiobook_rematch_window_hint: Number of characters to search forward per cue in the text. Adjust if hit rate is low; too large may skew cursor with short noisy cues.
audiobook_studio_cast_evidence_anaphoric: Inferred from a pronoun or title
audiobook_studio_cast_failure_bad_output: The AI reply could not be understood
audiobook_studio_cast_hint: Use AI to mark who speaks each line, then give each character a voice
audiobook_studio_cast_no_ai: Assign an AI provider to audiobook casting in AI settings first
audiobook_studio_cast_reannotate_confirm: AI labels in the selected chapters will be replaced; your manual changes are kept
audiobook_studio_cast_review_hint: Unclear, low-confidence or unattributed lines; check these first
audiobook_studio_export_hint: One M4B file with chapters, cover and subtitles
audiobook_studio_export_unsupported: This ffmpeg build cannot write M4B chapters
audiobook_studio_failure_book_missing: The book file could not be opened
audiobook_studio_failure_cache_busy: Some sentences are playing and could not be regenerated
audiobook_studio_failure_voice_unavailab: The voice is not available on this device
audiobook_studio_hint: Synthesize the whole book with a read-aloud voice and import it as an audiobook
audiobook_studio_loudness_hint: Even out volume across voices and chapters (audiobook loudness targets)
audiobook_studio_loudness_skipped: Loudness was not normalized: this ffmpeg build lacks the loudnorm filter
audiobook_studio_online_warning: Online services may rate-limit whole-book synthesis
audiobook_studio_pause_hint: Extra silence between sentences, paragraphs, scenes and chapters
audiobook_studio_pronunciation_hint: Change how words are read, e.g. 今日 → きょう
audiobook_studio_replace_warning: This book already has an audiobook; it will be replaced when done
audiobook_studio_verify_hint: Transcribe the result and flag misread or skipped sentences
audiobook_studio_verify_unavailable: No speech recognition model is installed
audiobook_subtitle_source_transcribe_hin: Generate from the selected audio with the on-device speech model
audiobook_transcribe_audio_incomplete: The audio file is damaged or not fully downloaded, so only part of it can be decoded. Re-download or replace the file, then transcribe again.
audiobook_transcribe_engine_cloud_hint: Uploads audio to $name · billed by it
audiobook_transcribe_engine_cloud_unset: Assign a provider to Cloud transcription in Settings › AI first (model: a Whisper model such as whisper-large-v3).
audiobook_transcribe_engine_system_hint: Uses the built-in speech model — no 1 GB download from us. The system still fetches its own language assets the first time, and keeps them shared across apps.
audiobook_transcribe_engine_system_insta: Asking the system to install the language…
audiobook_transcribe_engine_system_no_pa: This engine can't pause mid-file — stopping discards the current file's progress.
audiobook_transcribe_fallback: GPU unavailable, fell back to CPU: $reason
audiobook_transcribe_gpu_description: Speeds up transcription. Not bundled with the app: it is downloaded together with a speech model, matched to your graphics card.
audiobook_transcribe_gpu_detected_none: No usable graphics card: CPU only
audiobook_transcribe_gpu_offer_cpu: Transcription will run on the CPU. Download the $name runtime to use your graphics card.
audiobook_transcribe_gpu_offer_faster: Download the $name runtime for faster transcription on this graphics card.
audiobook_transcribe_gpu_unsupported: This graphics card or driver can't run the selected runtime (CUDA needs an NVIDIA RTX 20 series or newer card and driver 580+).
audiobook_transcribe_intro: Transcribes the audio locally with an on-device speech model for the selected language and generates subtitles for alignment. Nothing is uploaded.
audiobook_transcribe_match_after_use: Text matching and import run after you tap Use subtitles
audiobook_transcribe_model_custom_blank_: The blank symbol in tokens.txt. sherpa-onnx exports use <blk>; Omnilingual uses <s>. Getting it wrong garbles the whole transcript.
audiobook_transcribe_model_custom_detach: Only removes it from the model list. Your files are not deleted.
audiobook_transcribe_model_custom_error_: No .onnx model file in that folder.
Found an encoder but no decoder / joiner next to it.
audiobook_transcribe_model_custom_intro: Point Fushi at a folder holding a sherpa-onnx export (encoder / decoder / joiner, or a single CTC model, plus tokens.txt). The files stay where they are — only the small VAD model (640 KB) is fetched if the folder has none.
audiobook_transcribe_model_discarded: The model file could not be read and was removed. Download it again.
audiobook_transcribe_model_fit_desktop: Large — best on a desktop GPU
audiobook_transcribe_model_fit_heavy_mob: Large — runs on phones, but slowly
audiobook_transcribe_model_fit_light: Light — fine on phones and desktop
audiobook_transcribe_model_scope_dedicat: Dedicated — most accurate for this language
audiobook_transcribe_model_scope_multili: Multilingual — wide coverage, less accurate per language
audiobook_transcribe_options_changed_hin: Options changed. This subtitle was made with the previous ones; tap Re-transcribe to regenerate it with the new options.
audiobook_transcribe_paused_hint: Progress is saved. Pick the same audio files later to resume.
audiobook_transcribe_probe_failed_hint: Couldn't check this device's GPU acceleration, so transcription runs on the CPU. It's slower, but the result is the same.
audiobook_transcribe_proofread_done: AI proofreading done: $changed lines changed, $skipped blocks kept as is
audiobook_transcribe_proofread_failed: AI proofreading failed: $reason. The transcript was not changed.
audiobook_transcribe_proofread_hint: AI proofread fixes misheard words and adds punctuation; the number of lines and the timing stay the same.
audiobook_transcribe_proofread_unset: Assign a provider to Subtitle proofreading in Settings › AI first.
audiobook_transcribe_remote_model_missin: $device has no model for this language
audiobook_transcribe_retranscribe_hint: To transcribe again with different options, change the language, model or acceleration above.
audiobook_transcribe_status_skipped: A book with this title is already in the library; skipped
audiobook_transcribe_task_subtitle: Audiobook · transcribe and add to library
audiobook_transcribe_unavailable: On-device transcription is not available on this platform
audiobook_tts_category_external_hint: GPT-SoVITS, Irodori and other services on this computer or network
audiobook_tts_category_system_hint: The voice built into this device, works offline
audiobook_tts_concurrency_hint: Sending more requests at once synthesizes faster if the server and GPU can keep up; online services may rate-limit
audiobook_tts_empty_book: This book has no text to read aloud
audiobook_tts_failure_bad_response: The speech service returned invalid audio
audiobook_tts_failure_busy: The speech service is busy with another job
audiobook_tts_failure_network: Could not reach the speech service
audiobook_tts_failure_not_configured: The voice is not fully configured
audiobook_tts_failure_rate_limited: The speech service is rate limiting requests
audiobook_tts_failure_rejected: The speech service refused this sentence
audiobook_tts_failure_server: The speech service reported an error
audiobook_tts_failure_timeout: The speech service took too long to respond
audiobook_tts_failure_unauthorized: The speech service rejected the request (check the key)
audiobook_tts_failure_unsupported: This voice is not available on this device
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_add: Set up Irodori-TTS on this computer
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_add_hint: Download the official Irodori-TTS server and run it here, no command line needed
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_create_voice: Then pick one of the service voices and play a test
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_delete_confi: This stops the service and deletes ${path}, including the voices you uploaded.
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_dir_hint: Needs about 6–12 GB free. Python, packages, models and your uploaded voices all live in one folder and are deleted together.
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_editor_not_i: No local service yet? Set up Irodori-TTS on this computer in one step
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_failure_envi: Setting up the Python environment failed. Check the install log and try again.
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_failure_unsu: This computer is not supported (needs 64-bit Windows, an Apple silicon Mac or 64-bit Linux)
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_intro: Installs the official Irodori-TTS server with its own Python and PyTorch (2–6 GB) plus the v4.1 model (about 3.5 GB), all inside one folder. A short voice sample is enough to read in that voice, or you can describe a voice in words. It starts automatically when reading aloud and stops when Fushi exits.
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_model_mf: v4.1 Small MF (several times faster, good for CPU)
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_model_missin: The selected model is not downloaded yet. Download and install fetches only the model.
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_port_invalid: Use a port from 1024 to 65535, other than 7870, 7871 and 9880
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_step_package: Installing PyTorch and other packages (several GB, this can take a while)…
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_upload_exist: A voice with that ID already exists
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_upload_faile: Upload failed. Check the file and that the service is running.
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_upload_hint: A clean clip of one speaker (WAV, FLAC, MP3 …), a few seconds up to two minutes
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_voice_delete: Delete voice ${id} from the service? Its audio file is removed.
Could not delete this voice (only uploaded voices can be deleted)
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_voices_empty: No uploaded voices yet. The built-in voice "none" reads without a reference.
audiobook_tts_irodori_local_voices_need_: Start the service to manage its voices
audiobook_tts_local_add: Set up GPT-SoVITS on this computer
audiobook_tts_local_add_hint: Download the official package and run it here, no command line needed
audiobook_tts_local_cancelled: Cancelled. The next install resumes the download.
audiobook_tts_local_create_voice: Create a voice with this service
audiobook_tts_local_create_voice_hint: Then pick a reference audio clip and play a test
audiobook_tts_local_delete_confirm: This stops the service and deletes ${path} (about 19 GB).
audiobook_tts_local_delete_failed: Could not delete ${path} (${reason}). Close any program using it and try again.
audiobook_tts_local_dir_hint: Needs about 30 GB free; the download is deleted after extraction
audiobook_tts_local_editor_not_installed: No local service yet? Set up GPT-SoVITS on this computer in one step
audiobook_tts_local_failure_corrupt: The downloaded file failed verification and was deleted. Please try again.
audiobook_tts_local_failure_disk: Cannot write to the install location
audiobook_tts_local_failure_extract: Extraction failed. Make sure the disk has enough free space.
audiobook_tts_local_failure_layout: The extracted files do not look like a GPT-SoVITS package
audiobook_tts_local_failure_network: The download failed. Check your network or switch the download source and try again; it resumes where it stopped.
audiobook_tts_local_failure_no_extractor: This version of Windows cannot extract 7z archives. Update Windows, or extract the package yourself and choose "Use an extracted package".
audiobook_tts_local_gpu_none: No NVIDIA graphics card found: it will run on the CPU, which is much slower
audiobook_tts_local_install_hint: Interrupted downloads resume where they left off
audiobook_tts_local_intro: Downloads the official GPT-SoVITS package (about 11 GB, about 19 GB once extracted). Once installed, a 3-10 second voice sample is all it needs to read in that voice. It starts automatically when reading aloud and stops when Fushi exits.
audiobook_tts_local_remove_hint: Fushi only forgets it; no files are deleted.
audiobook_tts_local_server_failed_exited: The service stopped while starting. Check the log.
audiobook_tts_local_server_failed_missin: The package is incomplete. Please reinstall it.
audiobook_tts_local_server_failed_spawn: Could not start the service process
audiobook_tts_local_server_failed_timeou: The service did not become ready in time. Check the log.
audiobook_tts_local_server_starting: Starting… loading the models can take a minute or two the first time
audiobook_tts_local_server_stopped: Not running (starts automatically when reading aloud)
audiobook_tts_local_status_installed: Installed; starts automatically when reading aloud
audiobook_tts_local_status_not_installed: Not installed; tap to download and set up
audiobook_tts_local_use_existing_hint: Choose the GPT-SoVITS package folder (with runtime and api_v2.py)
audiobook_tts_local_use_existing_invalid: No GPT-SoVITS package was found in that folder
audiobook_tts_no_voice: Set up a read-aloud voice first
audiobook_tts_online_notice: Online service: the text being read is sent to the provider.
audiobook_tts_param_bearer_hint: Only needed when the server sits behind an authenticating gateway
audiobook_tts_param_caption_hint: Optional. Describe the voice and delivery, e.g. a calm, low female voice. With the voice "none" this designs a new voice from the description.
audiobook_tts_param_irodori_endpoint_hin: Irodori studio uses port 7870, the GPT-SoVITS studio 7871
audiobook_tts_param_irodori_server_endpo: The official Irodori-TTS server uses port 8088
audiobook_tts_param_ref_audio_copy_faile: Could not copy the reference audio
audiobook_tts_param_ref_audio_hint: A path on the machine running GPT-SoVITS; 3-10 seconds of clean speech
audiobook_tts_param_ref_audio_length: The reference audio is ${seconds} s; GPT-SoVITS only accepts 3-10 s
audiobook_tts_param_ref_audio_local_hint: 3-10 seconds of clean speech; the file is copied into Fushi's data folder
audiobook_tts_param_voicepeak_emotion_hi: Optional, e.g. happy=50,sad=0 (each 0-100). The names depend on the narrator.
audiobook_tts_param_voicevox_endpoint_hi: Default ports: VOICEVOX 50021, AivisSpeech 10101, SHAREVOX 50025. Other VOICEVOX-compatible engines (LMROID, ITVOICE and so on) also work: enter their address here.
audiobook_tts_param_voicevox_scale_hint: Optional. Leave empty for the engine default (speed, intonation and volume 1.0, pitch 0.0)
audiobook_tts_provider_voicepeak_hint: Paid software; uses the installed VOICEPEAK command line
audiobook_tts_provider_voicevox_hint: Free local engine with a VOICEVOX-compatible API
audiobook_tts_retry_hint: Press play to try again, or skip to the next sentence
audiobook_tts_unofficial_notice: Unofficial interface: Microsoft may change or block it at any time.
audiobook_tts_voice_empty: No voices yet. Add one to read books aloud.
audiobook_tts_voice_incomplete: The read-aloud voice is not fully configured
audiobook_tts_voice_regenerate_hint: Stop reusing audio already synthesized with this voice
audiobook_tts_voice_settings_hint: GPT-SoVITS, Microsoft, Google or the system voice
audiobook_tts_voicepeak_not_found: VOICEPEAK was not found on this computer. It is paid software that Fushi cannot download for you: buy and install it from the official site (voicepeak.jp), then come back and tap "Find installed VOICEPEAK", or choose voicepeak.exe yourself.
audiobook_tts_voicevox_local_add_hint: Free Japanese voices; downloads about ${size} from the official release
audiobook_tts_voicevox_local_create_voic: Then pick a character and style and play a test
audiobook_tts_voicevox_local_delete_conf: This stops the service and deletes ${path}.
audiobook_tts_voicevox_local_editor_not_: No local service yet? Set up ${engine} on this computer in one step
audiobook_tts_voicevox_local_failure_lay: The extracted files do not contain a runnable engine
audiobook_tts_voicevox_local_failure_no_: No tool to unpack the package was found. On Linux install unzip (VOICEVOX) or p7zip (AivisSpeech); on Windows, update the system.
audiobook_tts_voicevox_local_failure_uns: There is no official package for this platform
audiobook_tts_voicevox_local_intro: Downloads the official ${engine} engine ${version} (about ${size}) from GitHub. It starts automatically when reading aloud and stops when Fushi exits.
audiobook_tts_voicevox_local_port_invali: Use a port from 1024 to 65535, other than 7870, 7871, 8088 and 9880
audiobook_tts_voicevox_local_terms_aivis: Each AivisSpeech voice model has its own license. Check it before publishing generated audio.
audiobook_tts_voicevox_local_terms_voice: Each VOICEVOX character has its own terms of use. When you publish generated audio, credit it as "VOICEVOX:character name" (for example VOICEVOX:ずんだもん).
audiobookshelf_browse_load_failed: Could not load from the server
audiobookshelf_item_no_audio: This item has no audio files
audiobookshelf_mark_finished_through: Mark this and all older as finished
audiobookshelf_subtitle_from_device: Choose a file on this device
audiobookshelf_subtitle_message: Subtitles let you look up words and make cards while you listen.
audiobookshelf_subtitle_none_hint: Works like a normal audiobook or podcast. You can add a subtitle later while it is open.
audiobookshelf_subtitle_none_on_server: No subtitle files were found next to the audio
auto_add_char_position_to_tags_hint: Tags each card with chars_12345 — how many characters into the book it was mined.
auto_select_search_window_hint: Probe multiple window sizes on import, pick the one with the best hit rate
backup_category_games_desc: Game library, metadata sources and covers
backup_category_music_desc: Playlists, chosen lyrics sources, music-video links and play history (not the scanned library or covers)
backup_category_srs_desc: Review notes and history, plus card images and audio (count = notes + media files). Tied to profiles: if profiles aren't restored too, it's merged into the matching profile on this device
backup_export_categories_hint: Tick what to pack into the backup. Unchecking Books removes those books entirely — their content and records go with them.
backup_export_dictionaries_skipped: Exported, but $n dictionary(s) were skipped: their files are missing on this device ($names)
backup_export_hint: Choose what to include. Reading data (progress, stats, settings) is always included; uncheck Books to exclude books entirely, or uncheck large items (local audio, videos) to shrink the backup.
backup_import_confirm:
This will replace all current data with the backup from $date.

$bookCount books, $statsCount statistics records.

The app will restart after restore.
backup_import_contents_hint: Untick an item to skip it.
backup_import_hint: Restore from a backup file. The app will restart.
backup_import_merge_preview: Merge will add $bookCount books and update $progressCount reading positions.
backup_import_overlay_warning: Restoring your data. Please don't close the app.
backup_import_preserve_sync_note: Your sync settings on this device (account and credentials) will be kept.
backup_import_settings_off_hint: Keep this device's fonts/appearance/profiles; restore only books & reading data.
backup_import_settings_on_hint: Full restore: fonts, appearance and profiles come from the backup.
backup_import_validating_hint: Checking and previewing the backup file. This may take a moment.
backup_legacy_schema: This backup comes from the old Hibiki app or an early version (data schema older than v75), which this version can no longer import. Your current data has not been changed. To migrate: install Fushi v$version (the bridge release that still contains the full upgrade path), import the backup there, then update to the current version. Download: $url
backup_schema_newer: This backup requires a newer version of the app (schema $version). Please update first.
batch_delete_confirm: Delete $n book(s)? This cannot be undone.
batch_delete_confirm_video: Delete $n video(s)? This cannot be undone.
batch_delete_mixed_confirm: Delete $n media and dissolve $m collection(s)? This cannot be undone.
batch_dissolve_confirm: Dissolve $m collection(s)? Grouping is removed; the media is kept.

book_convert_blocked_already: This book is already in that format.

First, fully close the game and launch it again: the game process may still hold the component injected by an earlier session. If it still mismatches, the component files on disk are older than Fushi, because the last Fushi update could not replace them while a game was running. Close every game, then run the Fushi installer again.

manga_ocr_ai_mode_desc: Text boxes are still found on this device; a vision model re-reads the text inside them. Cropped text boxes are uploaded to the provider assigned in Settings › Models › LLM and billed by it, together with the local result and nearby text to help it decide. "Only uncertain text" picks boxes by the local model's confidence; engines without a confidence score (Google Lens, system OCR) are judged by obvious misreads such as garbled characters or text in the wrong script. Choose "All text" to re-read everything.
manga_ocr_ai_mode_low_confidence_legacy: Volumes recognized before confidence was recorded are judged by obvious misreads only. To pick uncertain text by confidence, recognize the volume again with a local model.
manga_ocr_ai_mode_no_provider: No AI provider is assigned to manga OCR yet, so nothing is sent.
manga_ocr_ai_mode_pending: Not decided yet: you'll be asked the first time uncertain text would be sent.
manga_ocr_ctc_desc: Reads each text column on its own with a manga-tuned PP-OCRv6 model. Small download and fast, and accurate even on furigana-heavy pages. Model: Kellenok/PP-OCRv6_manga (trained with Manga109-s and AnimeText).
manga_ocr_delete_confirm_message: This frees disk space. You can download them again later.
manga_ocr_download_background_hint: You can leave this page — the download continues in the background.

manga_ocr_engine_external_desc: Calls a mokuro command line you installed yourself. Desktop only.
manga_ocr_engine_google_lens_desc: Needs internet and uploads page images to Google. Fast with no download, but quality is below the local model.
manga_ocr_engine_local_onnx_desc: Fully offline. Download the selected model once; speed and accuracy depend on the model and hardware.

manga_ocr_engine_paired_host_desc: Hands the work to the paired Fushi interconnect server. Nothing is downloaded here.

manga_ocr_engine_system_desc: Uses the text recognition built into your device. No download, fully offline, nothing uploaded — but noticeably weaker on vertical speech bubbles and handwriting than the local model.

mining_audio_head_pad_hint: Extra audio kept before the subtitle starts, so the first syllable is not clipped. Never runs into the previous line.

network_proxy_p2p_warning: Direct by default. Via proxy: all P2P traffic goes through the global proxy — speed may drop, and many proxy providers forbid BitTorrent traffic (throttling, warnings, or account termination). Mixed: tracker requests go through the proxy while DHT and peer connections stay direct — widest peer discovery, but your real IP is visible to trackers, DHT and peers (connectivity only, not privacy). Built-in engine only; external qBittorrent uses its own proxy settings.

onboarding_anki_auto_reposition_hint: About 30 seconds after you mine, new cards in that deck are reordered by word frequency so common words come first. Review cards are never touched. Needs desktop Anki with AnkiConnect (a phone can use it by connecting to AnkiConnect on a computer); AnkiDroid and AnkiMobile can't reorder cards.
onboarding_anki_fsrs_body: Anki has FSRS built in — one of the best spaced-repetition algorithms around — but it keeps scheduling with SM-2 from the 1980s until you turn FSRS on. FSRS reads your real review history and predicts when you are about to forget, so you keep the same retention with fewer reviews. You flip this switch once, inside Anki; nothing changes on the Fushi side.
onboarding_anki_fsrs_srs_note: Fushi's built-in review already uses FSRS-7 by default. You only need the steps below if you also review in Anki.
onboarding_anki_fsrs_step_optimize_desc: Press Optimize under the switch to fit the parameters to your own review history, then save. Below roughly 1000 reviews the defaults already beat SM-2, so just optimize again once you have studied for a while.
onboarding_anki_fsrs_step_options_deskto: In Anki, click the gear next to a deck and choose Options.
onboarding_anki_fsrs_step_options_mobile: In AnkiDroid (2.17 or newer) or AnkiMobile, long-press the deck and choose Options.
onboarding_anki_fsrs_step_toggle_desc: Scroll to the FSRS section at the bottom of the options page (older builds hide it under Advanced) and turn the switch on. It applies to your whole collection, so once is enough.

onboarding_anki_setup_ios_hint: With AnkiMobile installed, cards are added directly. For the full feature set, connect to Anki on a computer in the same network via AnkiConnect.

Applies to every Lapis note on this device, including the ones imported now. You can also do this later from Note types.
srs_anki_migrate_setup_notice_background: Migration runs in the background, so you can leave this page. Progress and the full report appear in the task bar at the top of the deck list.

srs_anki_migrate_setup_notice_restore: Notes you imported before and later deleted in Fushi are restored, and their cards return to their original decks.

srs_import_needs_kernel: This package uses Anki's newer format, which needs the scheduling engine. The engine isn't available on this device.
srs_import_report_conflicts_kind_mismatc: $n notes of note type "$name" were skipped: the matching note type in Fushi is a different kind (standard vs. cloze)
srs_import_report_conflicts_missing_type: $n notes were skipped because their note type is missing from the package
srs_import_report_conflicts_type_changed: $n notes of note type "$name" were skipped: they already exist in Fushi under a different note type. To import them, use Change note type in Browse to switch those notes to "$name", then import again
srs_import_report_default_algorithm: Preset "$preset" had no FSRS parameters in Anki (SM-2 or never optimized), so its decks use Fushi's default, RWKV
srs_import_report_default_fsrs: Preset "$preset" had no FSRS parameters in Anki (SM-2 or never optimized), so its decks use FSRS-7 with default parameters
srs_import_report_fsrs: Preset "$preset" came with $alg parameters; its decks now use Fushi's default, RWKV, which queues reviews by how well you remember each card right now. The $alg parameters are kept: to stay on $alg, choose Keep FSRS below or switch back in deck settings › Algorithm
srs_import_report_future: $n cards have times in the future and were imported without their schedule
srs_import_report_invalid_params: Preset "$preset": its parameters were invalid and were not imported
srs_import_report_lapis_failed: Converting old Lapis notes to Fushi card failed. The import itself is complete; you can retry from Note types.
srs_import_report_media_missing: $n referenced media files are missing from the package
srs_import_report_notetypes_duplicated: Note type “$name” differs from the one here and was imported as a separate note type
srs_import_report_presets_skipped: Deck presets not imported: $n (new decks use the default settings)
srs_import_report_removed: $n fields or templates deleted in the source are kept here
srs_import_report_reset_new: Imported as new cards without review progress: $n
srs_import_report_rwkv: Preset "$preset" used RWKV in Anki and keeps using it
srs_import_report_rwkv_on_fsrs: Preset "$preset" used RWKV in Anki; RWKV was off for this import, so its decks use FSRS-7
srs_import_report_steps_removed: Deck "$preset": steps $removed were removed and are now scheduled by FSRS
srs_import_task_stopping: Stopping import of $name… (already imported notes are kept)
srs_import_update_notes_help: When a note already exists here: “If newer” updates it only if it was changed in the package after your last change here; “Always” always takes the content from the package; “Never” keeps what you have.
srs_import_update_notetypes_help: The same choice for note types: their name, styling and card templates.
srs_import_use_rwkv_help: Decks created by this import use RWKV, Fushi's default scheduler. FSRS parameters imported from the package are kept, so you can switch back later. When off, decks keep the package's FSRS algorithm (FSRS-7 if it has none or FSRS parameters aren't imported, including presets that used RWKV in Anki).
srs_import_with_deck_configs_help: Decks created by this import take the learning steps, daily limits, maximum interval and audio settings from the package. When off they use the default settings. The algorithm and FSRS parameters have their own switch. Decks that already exist are never changed.
srs_import_with_fsrs_params_help: Decks created by this import take the FSRS parameters and desired retention from the package, plus its FSRS algorithm when RWKV is off. When off they use Fushi's defaults (RWKV, or FSRS-7 optimized automatically from your reviews when RWKV is off). Decks that already exist are never changed.
srs_import_with_scheduling_help: Imports review history, due dates and suspended state. When off, every card is imported as a new card, no review history is imported, and the marked / leech tags are removed. Turn it on when importing your own backup; leave it off for decks shared by others.
srs_lapis_migration_backfill_summary: $n migrated notes have empty fields whose pre-migration content still exists. Only empty fields are filled; existing content is never overwritten.
srs_lapis_migration_backfill_title: Fill fields missed by earlier migrations
srs_lapis_migration_cards: $linked cards keep their review history, $dropped cards no longer appear
srs_lapis_migration_confirm: Migrate $n notes of “$name” to Fushi Card?
srs_lapis_migration_entry_summary: $n notes can be migrated or have missed fields
srs_lapis_migration_fallback: $n notes fill an empty field from another field with the same meaning
srs_lapis_migration_intro: Old Lapis note types (built-in, imported from Anki, or renamed) move to Fushi Card. Fields map by meaning, review history moves with the cards, and nothing is written until you confirm.
srs_lapis_migration_lost: No matching field in Fushi Card (content stays on the note, not migrated): $fields
srs_lapis_migration_nothing: Nothing to migrate: no old Lapis notes and no missed fields.
srs_lapis_migration_reminder_title: Migrate old Lapis notes to Fushi Card
srs_migrate_fushi_confirm: Migrate $n Lapis notes to Fushi Card? Fields map by name and review history moves with the cards.
srs_migrate_fushi_not_lapis: Only Lapis notes can be migrated
srs_mining_builtin_mapping_hint: Built-in note types use their built-in field mapping.
srs_mining_deck_fallback: The selected deck was deleted; cards go to the default deck.
srs_mining_note_type_fallback: The selected note type was deleted; cards use Lapis.
srs_mining_required_unmapped: Required fields are not mapped: $fields. Cards mined now would be empty (a card whose first field is empty is refused).
srs_mining_target_hint: Where a card goes when you mine a word
srs_module_switch_hint: Fushi's built-in spaced repetition: decks, FSRS-7 scheduling, review on any device
srs_note_delete_confirm: Delete this note and all of its cards?
srs_note_delete_conflict: Deleted on one device while edited on another.
srs_note_field_ai_custom_hint: Tell the AI what to write
srs_note_field_conflict: Changed on two devices at once — pick the value to keep:
srs_note_field_edit_text_empty: No editable text in this field
srs_note_field_structured_hint: Formatted dictionary content. Edit the HTML source to change it
srs_note_field_structured_wysiwyg_hint: Dictionary layout: tap Edit text to change the words right inside the layout; switch to source to change the structure
srs_note_format_ruby_select_hint: Select the text to annotate first
srs_note_format_ruby_single_line: A reading can't span multiple lines
srs_note_furigana_hint: Tap a word to change its reading
srs_note_types_builtin_hint: Built-in note types can be edited but not deleted. Mining and the review marks in the lookup popup rely on their built-in fields, so those fields can be renamed or reordered but not deleted.
srs_note_types_conflict: Another device changed this note type at the same time. Pick the version to keep:
srs_note_types_delete_confirm: Delete "$name"? Its $n notes and their cards will be deleted too.
srs_note_types_discard_body: Your changes to this card type haven't been saved.
srs_note_types_field_delete_confirm: Delete the field "$name"? $n notes have content in it, and that content will be lost.
srs_note_types_field_last: A note type needs at least one field
srs_note_types_fields_hint: What each note holds; open a field to see where it shows on the card
srs_note_types_flag_fields_hint: Put any character in one to turn that card style on
srs_note_types_freq_field_hint: In decks ordered by frequency, new cards come out by the rank in this field (smaller = more common). Auto uses the field named FreqSort.
srs_note_types_name_invalid: Field names can't contain : { } " or start with # /
srs_note_types_name_reserved: This name is reserved by Anki (FrontSide, Tags, Deck…)
srs_note_types_preview_empty: The front is empty for this note, so this card won't be shown.
srs_note_types_preview_placeholder: No notes yet. The preview fills each field with its name.
srs_note_types_styling_hint: Shared by all card types of this note type
srs_note_types_template_cloze_single: Cloze note types have exactly one card type
srs_note_types_template_delete_confirm: Delete the card type "$name"? $n cards made from it will be deleted.
srs_note_types_template_last: A note type needs at least one card type
srs_note_types_templates_hint: Each template makes one card; open one to change its layout
srs_note_types_term_field_hint: Review marks in the lookup popup match words against this field
srs_review_gestures_hint: Tap zones, double tap, long press and swipes on the card
srs_review_gestures_note: Taps and long presses only count on blank space: words, links, buttons and selected text keep their own behaviour. While the card can still scroll that way, a swipe is a scroll.
srs_review_gestures_rating_hidden: Inactive while only Again / Good are shown
srs_review_hide_hard_easy_hint: Keys 2 and 4 still rate Hard and Easy
srs_review_layout_floating_top_bar_hint: Hidden by default. Tap a blank spot on the card or right-click to show it, and again to hide it.
srs_review_layout_image_size_hint: Enlarge images that the deck styles keep small; tap an image to view it full screen
srs_review_layout_replay_button_hint: Within thumb reach when reviewing on a phone; the top bar keeps its replay
srs_review_layout_show_counts_hint: New · learning · review counts under the deck name
srs_review_layout_show_intervals: Show next interval on rating buttons
srs_review_layout_show_intervals_hint: A small label under each rating, so a mis-tap or an odd schedule stands out
srs_review_layout_volume_hint: Volume of card audio, both when tapped and when played automatically
srs_review_rwkv_pending: RWKV is not ready yet. Review cards in RWKV decks will appear once it is ready.
srs_review_undo_blocked: This card was already reviewed on another device, so this step can't be undone
srs_settings_algorithm_hint: A new algorithm applies from the next review; due dates already scheduled stay as they are. Use Reschedule deck now to apply it right away.
srs_settings_algorithm_unknown: This deck uses an algorithm from a newer version; this device uses $alg for now
srs_settings_auto_optimize_hint: Fit the scheduling parameters to your own review history from time to time
srs_settings_auto_optimize_rwkv_hint: For RWKV decks this fits the FSRS-7 parameters running underneath. They set the intervals shown on the answer buttons, the stored due dates (used for queueing while RWKV isn't ready) and the due dates exported to Anki. Runs by itself while the app is idle; there's no need to press Optimize now.
srs_settings_autoplay_audio_hint: Play the card's audio when the question or the answer is shown. The answer side skips audio carried over from the front.
srs_settings_children_inherit_confirm: Switch the $n sub-decks under this deck that have their own settings to "Same as parent"? Their target retention, algorithm, parameters and automatic optimization will then follow this deck. Their own steps and daily limits stay as they are.
srs_settings_children_inherit_hint: Some sub-decks below have their own scheduling settings (common after importing from Anki), so changes made here don't reach them.
srs_settings_conflict_replaced: Replaced by a change from another device
srs_settings_max_interval_hint: No card is scheduled further out than this
srs_settings_new_load_auto: Adjust new cards to review load
srs_settings_new_load_auto_hint: Review budget = your average daily reviews over the last 30 days × the percentage below (at least 10× the daily new card limit). Above the budget new cards shrink; above twice the budget they pause for the day.
srs_settings_new_load_boost: Extra new cards on light days (%)
srs_settings_new_load_boost_hint: When due reviews are below half the budget, new cards grow by up to this percentage. 0 = never add.
srs_settings_new_load_budget_hint: Lower = new cards shrink sooner when reviews pile up. Default 150.
srs_settings_new_order_frequency_hint: Common words first, by the frequency rank saved on each card when it was mined (FreqSort). The rank syncs with the note, so every device shows the same order. Cards without a rank come after, by position.
srs_settings_new_order_position_hint: By the position set with “Reorder new cards by frequency” or by an Anki import; cards never positioned come in the order they were added.
srs_settings_new_per_day_hint: When many reviews are due, Fushi automatically shows fewer new cards
srs_settings_optimize_kept: The current parameters already fit best; nothing changed
srs_settings_optimize_never: Not optimized yet; using the default parameters
srs_settings_optimize_not_enough: Not enough review history to optimize yet
srs_settings_replay_question_audio: Include question audio when replaying answer
srs_settings_replay_question_audio_hint: When off, Replay audio on the answer side plays only the answer's audio.
srs_settings_reschedule_confirm: Recompute the due dates of every review card in this deck with the current settings?
srs_settings_reset_params_confirm: Use the default scheduling parameters for this deck? Automatic optimization waits until you have more reviews.
srs_settings_retention_hint: The chance you still remember a card when it comes due. Higher means more reviews.
srs_settings_rwkv_failed: RWKV is unavailable: $error. Review cards in RWKV decks are paused until it works again.
srs_settings_rwkv_hint: RWKV estimates each card's recall right now from your whole review history with a neural network; a review card is shown once its estimated recall drops to the desired retention, whatever its due date. Stability, difficulty and the stored due date are still tracked with FSRS-7.
srs_settings_rwkv_ignore_limit_hint: Show every review card whose recall has dropped to the target retention, however many there are.
srs_settings_rwkv_min_reviews_hint: If fewer cards than this have been reviewed in this deck today, top up with the cards RWKV is least sure you remember, even above the desired retention. 0 turns it off.
srs_settings_rwkv_rebuild_hint: Replays your whole review history again. RWKV keeps itself up to date otherwise; this is only needed after moving cards to another deck or changing how a deck inherits its settings.
srs_settings_rwkv_refresh_every: Update the RWKV queue every N answers
srs_settings_rwkv_refresh_every_hint: How many answers to wait between full RWKV score updates. 1 updates after every answer (in the background, used from the next card). Higher values reduce the work RWKV does while you review, but the queue may use older estimates between updates.
srs_settings_rwkv_repeat_hint: A card answered today comes back only after both: this many answers to other cards in these decks, and this many seconds.
srs_settings_rwkv_retention_note: RWKV's recall estimate starts near your overall pass rate rather than at 100%: a desired retention above that rate brings cards back almost right away, and one well below it shows few reviews.
srs_settings_rwkv_steps_note: For RWKV decks, leave the learning and relearning steps blank: a card you miss goes straight back to the review queue and RWKV decides, by its recall, when to show it again (the same day included).
srs_settings_steps_empty_hint: Leave blank for no steps: cards go straight to review.
srs_settings_steps_hint: Separate with spaces, e.g. 1 10; each step must be shorter than a day
srs_settings_steps_invalid: Enter positive numbers of minutes, each shorter than one day
srs_starter_already_added: This deck is already in your decks
srs_starter_body: Starter decks download from their authors' release pages and import like any .apkg.
srs_stats_empty: No review history yet. Review a few cards and your statistics show up here.
srs_stats_future_due_by_recall: $n review cards in RWKV decks aren't counted: they come back when their estimated recall drops to the desired retention, not on a due date.
srs_stats_memory_empty: Nothing to show yet: review some cards first.
srs_stats_retention_hint: How often you remembered review cards when they came due. FSRS schedules for the desired retention; the closer the two, the better the parameters fit you.
srs_stats_retrievability_unavailable: The scheduling engine is not available on this device, so retrievability cannot be computed.
srs_stats_rwkv_now_hint: RWKV does not predict which day a card comes due. Due now: cards whose estimated recall has already dropped to the target retention. Near the target: cards less than 5 points above it, the next to come up. Daily reviews: what you actually reviewed in these decks over the last 30 days.
srs_stats_unavailable: Turn on the review module to see review statistics.
srs_storage_upgrade_no_space: Not enough free disk space to upgrade the review database. Free up at least $size and try again — nothing was changed.
srs_sync_auto_hint: Sync review data in the background after each regular sync, when a paired device has new review data, and shortly after you review. When off, review data only syncs when you tap Sync now in the deck list or open the Review tab (at most once a minute). Book and video progress sync is not affected
