srs_sync_awaiting_confirm: Review data will sync after you confirm on the review page
srs_sync_backend_unsupported: The current sync service doesn't support syncing review data
srs_sync_clock_skew: Your system clock is off by more than 10 minutes. Review times follow the sync server instead.
srs_sync_confirm_body: The first sync combines the review data on all your devices: notes and reviews from every device are kept, nothing is overwritten. If the same word was added on two devices, Sync conflicts will offer to merge them.
srs_sync_directory_unidentified: The sync folder can't be identified yet (account or address not ready)
srs_sync_location_meta_unavailable: The location's settings file can't be read right now; it will be retried next time.
srs_sync_no_backend: No sync service is set up
srs_sync_profile_conflict_adopt_hint: This device has no notes yet and will switch to the one you choose.
srs_sync_profile_conflict_body: This sync location has review data from other devices, and it isn't clear which one this device should use. Choose one:
srs_sync_profile_conflict_merge_hint: Notes and review history already on this device will be merged into the one you choose. Nothing is lost.
srs_sync_setup_body: Review data syncs along with cloud sync (Sync & backup) and Fushi Interconnect; there is no separate switch. Neither is set up on this device yet.
srs_sync_store_unavailable: SRS data isn't open on this device right now
srs_timeline_checkpoint_failed: Could not add a restore point
srs_timeline_checkpoints_empty_hint: One is added automatically before bulk deletes, imports, note type changes, new FSRS parameters and restores.
srs_timeline_cloud_hint: Review data syncs along with your cloud drive (Sync & backup) or Fushi Interconnect. Every change is kept in the history below, so there is nothing to back up by hand.
srs_timeline_digest_mismatch: Data differs from this device at the same point. Please report this.
srs_timeline_import_confirm: Changes in the file are merged into this profile. Nothing here is overwritten.
srs_timeline_import_invalid: This is not a Fushi review export, or it was made by a newer version
srs_timeline_import_other_profile: This file belongs to another profile
srs_timeline_location_add_hint: A USB drive, a NAS, or a folder another sync tool keeps in sync
srs_timeline_location_bad_kdf: This location's encryption parameters are invalid. Sync is paused.
srs_timeline_location_encrypt_body: Review data and media in this location are encrypted with a passphrase; the storage only sees ciphertext and file sizes. Every device syncing here needs the same passphrase. If you forget it, this location cannot be read, but each device still has all its data. Encryption cannot be turned off here later.
srs_timeline_location_encrypt_done: Encryption is on for this location
srs_timeline_location_encrypt_pending: Encryption turns on at the next sync
srs_timeline_location_encrypted_hint: This location is end-to-end encrypted. Other devices need the same passphrase to sync here.
srs_timeline_location_encryption_missing: This location's encryption settings are gone. Sync is paused so nothing is uploaded unencrypted — tap to restore them.
srs_timeline_location_purpose_archive_hi: Keep everything and never delete anything here, as an extra safety copy
srs_timeline_location_purpose_media_hint: Keep a copy of card images and audio here
srs_timeline_location_purpose_sync_hint: Exchange changes with other devices through this folder
srs_timeline_location_remove_confirm: Fushi stops syncing to this folder. Files already in it are kept.
srs_timeline_location_unlock_body: Another device turned on encryption for this location. Enter the same passphrase to sync here.
srs_timeline_restore_body: Notes, cards, decks and settings go back to how they were at $time. A restore point is added first, so you can undo this.
srs_timeline_restore_moment: Restore to a point in time
srs_timeline_restore_moment_hint: Pick a date and time. Restoring adds changes on top and syncs to every device; it can be undone.
srs_timeline_restore_retract_hint: Off: reviews done since then are kept and scheduling continues from them.
srs_timeline_waiting_hint: They come from another device and are applied as soon as the changes they depend on arrive.
srs_visual_ai_descriptions_pending: AI also wrote descriptions for ${count} fields; they are saved with the template.
srs_visual_ai_hint: e.g. Put the word big in the middle, sentence below, reading and audio on the back
srs_visual_ai_replace_body: AI's layout replaces a template written in code (or edited by hand). Nothing is saved until you tap Save, and you can still discard.
srs_visual_builtin_body: It uses card-type switches (word / sentence / click / audio card) and scripts that the visual editor cannot express, so it is shown as code. Untouched built-in templates update together with Fushi.
srs_visual_builtin_fushi_note: Generating a layout and saving makes this template your own version: it no longer follows app updates, and reviews stop using the native Fushi card face.
srs_visual_builtin_other_note: Generating a layout and saving makes this template your own version: it no longer follows app updates or the upstream template.
srs_visual_builtin_title: This is a built-in template, written in code
srs_visual_convert_body: It probably came from Anki or an older version. Generate a visual layout from the fields to edit it by dragging blocks; the code is replaced only after you save.
srs_visual_convert_title: This template is written in code
srs_visual_edited_warning: The code of this side was edited by hand. Changing it here regenerates the code and drops those hand edits.
srs_visual_empty: Nothing on this side yet. Add a field to start.
srs_visual_filter_cloze_hint: Show {{c1::…}} cloze deletions as blanks on the front.
srs_visual_filter_furigana_hint: Content in 漢字[かな] form shows the kana above the kanji.
srs_visual_filter_hint_hint: Folded into a link; tap it during review to reveal.
srs_visual_filter_kana_hint: Show only the readings of 漢字[かな] content.
srs_visual_filter_kanji_hint: Drop the [reading] parts and show only the written form.
srs_visual_generate_confirm_body: Both sides are regenerated from the fields. Nothing is saved until you tap Save, and you can still discard.
srs_visual_prop_hide_empty_hint: The whole block, caption included, disappears when the field is empty.
srs_visual_prop_image_size_hint: Width of pictures in this field, relative to the card
srt_audio_unresolved: Audio file not found — please re-attach
srt_book_attach_epub_remove_old_hint: A new audiobook with the book text was created. You can delete the old subtitle-only book.
srt_book_reimport_body_rebuilt: Book text rebuilt — reopen the book to read it
srt_book_reimport_no_cues: No subtitle lines found in that file
srt_book_reimport_subtitle_hint: Replacing the subtitle rebuilds the book text from the new cues.
srt_import_audio_needs_subtitle: Audio must be paired with subtitles. To attach audio to an existing book, long-press the book on the shelf.
srt_import_hint_epub_or_srt: Pick a book or subtitle file to import.
srt_import_missing_input: Please pick at least a book or subtitle file
startup_module_hint: Page shown when the app opens. Only enabled modules can be picked; if the chosen one is turned off, the first page in the bar is used.
stash_added_multiple: Multiple items have been added to the Stash.
stash_clear_description: All contents will be cleared. Are you sure?
stash_nothing_to_pop: No items to be popped from the Stash.
stat_center_day_reset_hour_hint: Reading, watching and gaming before this hour count toward the previous day. Affects today and the last N days in statistics; only records written after the change use the new boundary.
stat_clear_all_game_message: Clear all game play time and session counts? Your game library and activity timeline are kept. This cannot be undone.
stat_clear_all_overview_message: Clear reading, watching and game statistics all at once? Time, character counts and lookup/mining counts across all three go away. Your saved words and sentences, mined cards, game library and activity timeline are kept. This cannot be undone.
stat_clear_all_reading_message: Clear all reading time, character counts, and lookup/mining counts? Your saved words, sentences, and mined cards are kept. This cannot be undone.
stat_clear_all_video_message: Clear all watch time, subtitle character counts, and lookup/mining counts? Your saved words, sentences, and mined cards are kept. This cannot be undone.
stat_delete_message: Delete this item's time, character count, and lookup/mining statistics? Your saved words and sentences are not affected.
stat_hourly_unattributed_note: Hours recorded before per-format tracking existed have no type stored, so they cannot be split. They are shown as a combined total and are not assigned to any type.
stat_overview_empty: No study records yet. Read, watch or play and your statistics will show up here.
stat_session_delete_message: Delete this session's time, character and page counts? Your saved words and sentences are not affected.
stat_session_edit_chars_invalid: Characters must be a whole number of 0 or more.
stat_session_edit_message: Changing the date moves the whole session and keeps its time of day. The character count is split back across the session's segments.
stat_sessions_clear_all_ack: I understand this deletes all $n session records.
stat_sessions_clear_all_message: Clear all $n session records? Their time, character and page counts go away. Your saved words and sentences, mined cards and game library are kept. This cannot be undone.
storage_bundled_hint: Shipped with the installer; deleted files come back on the next update, listed for reference only.
storage_dictionary_delete_incomplete: Dictionary still present after deletion, see error log
storage_entry_backups_label: $n archive(s) left by the last export
storage_entry_delete_backups_confirm_bod: Delete these temporary local backup archives? Make sure you have saved or shared any copy you still need.
storage_entry_delete_book_confirm_body: This removes the book, its reading progress and paired audio copies from this device.
storage_entry_delete_database_snapshots_: This removes all leftover database backup snapshots (corrupt-bak / pre-restore / legacy migration copies). The live database and its -wal/-shm sidecars are not touched.
storage_entry_delete_dictionary_confirm_: This removes the dictionary and its imported data.
storage_entry_delete_files_confirm_body: This deletes it from disk right away. Nothing in your library references it - it is cached, exported or re-downloadable data.
storage_entry_delete_video_confirm_body: Removes this video from the library and deletes its file from this device.
storage_entry_external_audio_hint: Audio references the original files, using no app storage
storage_modules_anime4k_hint: Can be downloaded again anytime in video settings
storage_ocr_models_hint: Download or delete each local OCR model here. Which one is used is chosen in Manga › Manga OCR.
storage_permissions: Please grant the following permissions for exporting to AnkiDroid.
subscription_auto_disable_tooltip: Turn off ongoing subscriptions after no new episodes for
subscription_edit_filter_hint: Changing the release group or keywords only affects episodes that have not been downloaded yet.
subscription_items_empty_ongoing_hint: Ongoing subscriptions only queue new single-episode releases. If this title has finished airing, or you subscribed from a batch release, download the batch once instead.
subscription_legacy_hint: Imported from the legacy system; automatic checks do not apply.
subscription_remote_provider_unavailable: The host has no indexer for this resource ($provider)
subscription_remote_unsupported: The host has no download backend configured
sync_asset_download_hint: Fetches what the remote has and this device does not - including entries you deleted locally.
sync_asset_legacy_notice_body: This device had automatic syncing on for dictionaries and local audio databases. That switch is gone - use the Upload / Download actions below when you want to transfer them. Nothing was deleted, but new dictionaries are no longer backed up automatically.
sync_asset_legacy_notice_title: Dictionary and audio sync is now manual
sync_asset_transfer_hint: Upload what only this device has, or download what only the remote has
sync_asset_upload_hint: Sends what this device has and the remote does not. Packages can be large.
sync_audiobook_files_warning: Audio and subtitles can be large.
sync_auto_sync_cloud_hint: Cloud sync only. Fushi Interconnect has its own auto sync switch on the Interconnect page
sync_compare_delete_confirm: Delete "$name" from the remote? Local data is kept. This cannot be undone.
sync_compare_no_content: Cloud data only — no book to download
sync_compare_unavailable: Set up a sync backend first
sync_content_warning: Large files will use storage space and data
sync_desktop_oauth_browser_open_failed: Could not open the browser. Copy the link and open it in a browser yourself.
sync_desktop_oauth_link_copy_failed: Could not copy the link. Select the link text and copy it manually.
sync_desktop_oauth_waiting_body: The sign-in page was opened in your default browser. If nothing opened, or the page shows an error, copy the link and open it in another browser or a private window.
sync_err_auth_expired: Sign-in expired — please sign in again.
sync_err_browser_timeout: The browser never returned the authorization. Retry, and make sure your proxy lets 127.0.0.1 through.
sync_err_forbidden: The server refused this request. Your sign-in is fine - check the server's settings.
sync_err_forbidden_detail: The server refused this request: $reason (your sign-in is fine)
sync_err_html_page: The server answered with a web page instead of a sync response. Check that the URL points at a WebDAV or Fushi Interconnect endpoint, not a website.
sync_err_html_page_detail: The server answered with a web page ("$title") instead of a sync response. Check that the URL points at a WebDAV or Fushi Interconnect endpoint, not a website.
sync_err_invalid_client: Client credentials are invalid for this build — please update the app.
sync_err_network: Cannot reach the server — check your network or proxy settings.
sync_err_not_configured: Google sync credentials are not configured in this build.
sync_err_not_paired: No paired device yet — set up pairing in Fushi Interconnect first.
sync_err_pairing_rejected: The paired device rejected this device's credentials — pair again to resume syncing.
sync_err_peer_unreachable: Can't reach the Fushi Interconnect server - it may be offline or not running Fushi.
sync_err_scope_upgrade: Sync permissions changed — please sign in to Google again to continue syncing.
sync_err_timeout: Connection timed out — the server did not respond in time. Check your network or proxy settings.
sync_exit_warning: Sync is still in progress. Exiting now may cause data loss.
sync_interconnect_service_config_toggle_: Receive external service settings and API keys (Jimaku, TMDB, Torznab, OpenSubtitles, tracking) from the Fushi Interconnect server over the encrypted Interconnect channel. Requires TLS.
sync_lan_scan_failed: Scan failed — check network permissions or firewall.
sync_last_auto_disabled: Last sync: skipped - auto sync is off
sync_last_no_channels: Last sync: nothing synced - no connected sync channel
sync_manga_content_warning: Manga volumes are large and use more storage and data
sync_now_hint: Run a full two-way sync with the cloud now
sync_p2p_enable: Allow remote connections over a P2P tunnel
sync_p2p_enable_hint: For when neither side has a public IP. Uses iroh's relay and discovery servers, which can see this device's IP address. Video may be slow when the connection goes through a relay.
sync_p2p_relay_only_hint: Stuck on the relay (slower). Hole punching usually fails when Clash TUN, a global VPN or a similar tool rewrites UDP ports on either device — add Fushi or UDP traffic to its direct rules.
sync_p2p_relay_urls_hint: One iroh-relay URL per line. Leave empty to use iroh's public relays.
sync_pair_confirm_identity_body: You are pairing with $device. Confirm this is the device you expect before continuing.
sync_pair_enter_pin_body: Enter the 6-digit PIN shown on the other device.
sync_pair_expired: Pairing timed out. Start pairing again from this device.
sync_pair_fingerprint_changed: Certificate changed — pairing aborted for safety (possible interception).
sync_pair_fingerprint_changed_body: This address was pinned to a different certificate before. Continue only if you know the peer reinstalled or reset it — otherwise someone may be intercepting the connection.
sync_pair_link_invalid: This is not a valid Fushi pairing link
sync_pair_link_unreachable: None of the addresses in this pairing link are reachable, or they point to a different device
sync_pair_nfc_failed: Couldn't write the NFC tag. Make sure NFC is on and the tag is writable.
sync_pair_nfc_lock_hint: Locking can't be undone. Nobody can rewrite the sticker into a malicious link, but if this device's address or certificate changes you can't update it either — you'll need a new sticker.
sync_pair_nfc_lock_unsupported: Written, but this sticker can't be locked
sync_pair_nfc_write_hint: Hold an NFC tag to the back of the phone. The tag only stores this device's addresses; pairing still needs approval on the host.
sync_pair_not_fushi: No Fushi device found at this address. The address was saved.
sync_pair_not_fushi_discovered: No Fushi device found at this address.
sync_pair_peer_not_https: The peer isn't using HTTPS on this port. Use an http:// address.
sync_pair_peer_requires_https: This device only accepts HTTPS. Use an https:// address.
sync_pair_pin_label: Enter this PIN on the other device
sync_pair_pin_waiting: Waiting for the other device to enter this PIN…
sync_pair_qr_hint: Scan this with Fushi on the other device. Valid for 5 minutes and for one device; closing this window revokes it.
sync_pair_qr_no_address: No reachable address to put in the QR code. Check that this device is connected to a network.
sync_pair_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
sync_pair_request_body: A device is requesting to pair. Allow it to sync with this device?
sync_pair_timeout: The peer did not respond in time.
sync_pair_tls_failed: Certificate check failed. The peer's certificate does not match the pinned one.
sync_pair_unavailable: The other device isn't ready or is on an older version. Update it and enable sync, then try again.
sync_pair_upgrade_required: The other device runs an older version that cannot pair securely from this network. Update it, then pair again.
sync_paired_peer_owner_mark: Mark as my device (can sign in with my Fushi account)
sync_peer_book_delete_confirm: Delete "$name" from the peer device? Its files and reading progress there are removed for good, and this device has no copy. This cannot be undone.
sync_peer_video_delete_confirm: Remove "$name" from the peer device's library? The peer's own imported video file is kept. This cannot be undone.
sync_position_conflict_message: These items were played on both this device and the paired device since the last sync. Choose which position to keep.
sync_role_locked_by_client: Already connected to another device. Remove the connection before hosting as a server.
sync_role_locked_by_server: This device is hosting as a server. Turn off the server before connecting to other devices.
sync_section_host_server: This device as a sync server
sync_section_host_server_footer: Let other devices sync from this device. Independent of the sync backend above.
sync_server_mode_active: This device is a sync server
sync_server_mode_clients_drive: Connected clients start the sync — no manual sync needed here.
sync_server_port_in_use: Port $port is already in use — pick a different port.
sync_server_public_urls_hint: One per line, e.g. https://home.example.com. Paired devices pick these up automatically.
sync_server_settings_hint: Credentials and connection test for the selected sync method
sync_server_tls_repair_hint: Changing this requires paired devices to pair again
sync_show_remote_entries_warning: Show books and videos that exist on the Fushi Interconnect server or the cloud as placeholder cards you can download or stream.
sync_video_files_warning: Video files can be very large.
sync_web_history_hint: Off by default. When on, the in-app browser's history syncs with cloud backup and paired devices. Bookmarks follow favorites.
tag_add_failed: Couldn't add the tag. Please try again.
tag_already_on_book: Tag "$name" is already on this book.
tag_already_on_collection: Tag $name is already on this collection.
tag_manage_merge_confirm: Everything tagged “$from” will be tagged “$to” instead, then “$from” is deleted.
tag_name_duplicate: A tag with this name already exists.
tag_no_books_for_filter: No books match the selected tags.
tag_no_tags_hint: No tags yet. Create one to get started.
tag_picker_partial_state: On some of the selected items
tag_picker_scope_collection_hint: Tags go on the collection itself. Filtering by the tag shows the whole collection.
tag_picker_scope_members_hint: Tags go on every item inside the selected collections. The collections themselves stay unchanged.
tag_reorder_failed: Couldn't save the new tag order. Please try again.
texthooker_enabled_hint: Connect to Textractor/mpv/agent and look up incoming text
theme_accent_auto_tone: Adjust tone for light and dark mode
theme_accent_auto_tone_desc: Off: the exact color is used. On: a lighter or darker tone is generated for each mode, so what you see differs from what you picked.
theme_accent_auto_tone_short: Separate tones for light and dark
theme_accent_follow_system_desc: Use the wallpaper color on Android (Material You) or the OS accent color on desktop instead of a picked color.
theme_accent_follow_system_short: Use the wallpaper or system accent
theme_accent_follow_system_unavailable: The system does not expose an accent color on this device.
theme_accent_low_contrast_dark: Hard to see on the dark-mode background. Pick a lighter color.
theme_accent_low_contrast_light: Hard to see on the light-mode background. Pick a darker color.
theme_ai_applied: AI suggestion loaded into the editor. Check the preview, then apply.
theme_ai_card_desc: Describe the look you want — AI fills the colors into this draft.
theme_ai_hint: Describe the theme you want, e.g. warm paper reading theme with a dark green accent
theme_icon_accent_hint: Take the accent color from your custom icon image. Turn off to return to the theme you picked.
theme_logo_tint_hint: Recolor the built-in mascot icon to match the accent color. When off, the original artwork is always shown.
theme_neutral_derived_desc: Tags, selected items, menus and surfaces stay gray instead of taking on the accent's hue; only the accent color itself stands out (like the Windows light theme). White, gray or black accents do this automatically.
theme_neutral_derived_short: Only the theme color carries hue
theme_preview_hint: Pick a color to see where it is used outlined in the preview.
theme_pure_black_hint: Use true black backgrounds in dark mode (OLED)
theme_role_accent_desc: Used exactly as picked for buttons, switches, icons and progress bars. Every other color is derived from it.
theme_role_audio_highlight_desc: Follows audiobook playback. Applies to every theme, not just this one.
theme_role_container_desc: Switch tracks, floating buttons and the play bar
theme_role_link_desc: Hyperlinks inside books and the selection handles
theme_role_reader_background_desc: Reader page, toolbar and dictionary popup background
theme_role_reader_text_desc: Reader text, toolbar icons and dictionary popup text
theme_role_secondary_desc: Tags, badges and selected list items
theme_role_selection_desc: Background of the word or sentence being looked up
theme_role_surface_desc: Base color of pages, cards and menus; the other layers get a faint tint of gray from it.
torrent_upload_intro_body: Uploading (seeding) is off by default. Turn it on to share downloaded content back to the swarm — this uses your upload bandwidth. You can change this anytime in Settings.
tts_system_engine_unavailable: No system text-to-speech engine is available on this device. Pick another TTS voice in settings.
tts_system_language_missing_data: The system voice has no voice data for ${language}. Download it in the system text-to-speech settings, or pick another TTS voice in settings.
tts_system_language_unsupported: The system voice cannot speak ${language}. Pick another TTS voice in settings, or install a speech engine that supports this language.
tts_system_synthesis_failed: The system voice failed to generate audio.
tts_system_voice_unavailable: The selected system voice is no longer available (uninstalled, or this is a different device). Choose another voice in the read-aloud voice settings.
update_debug_channel_warning: Debug channel builds may be unstable. Use at your own risk.
update_download_source_preference_hint: The selected source is tried first; unavailable sources still fall back automatically.
update_download_source_unavailable: $source is not available for this file; falling back to the automatic order
update_install_elevation_declined: Fushi is installed in a folder that needs administrator rights, and the administrator prompt (UAC) was declined, so the update was not installed. Update again and choose "Yes" in the prompt.
update_install_gal_hook_holder: Galgame capture component in use: PID $pid - $path (this is the game you are playing, or its capture host). Close the game, then update again.
update_install_incomplete_message: The installer started, but Fushi is still on the previous version. Check the installer log below.
update_install_integrity_failed: The downloaded installer did not match the published checksum, so Fushi did not run it with administrator rights. Update again to download a fresh copy.
update_install_launch_failed_message: Fushi could not start the installer for version $version. Check the log path below.
update_install_log_not_observed: Installer log was not created during the post-launch check.
update_install_log_observed: Installer log was created during the post-launch check.
update_install_manual_close_retry: Close Fushi from the listed PID/path, then retry the update or run the installer again.
update_install_parent_exit_not_observed: The update launcher did not observe Fushi exiting before the installer launch.
update_install_parent_exit_observed: Fushi exited before the installer was launched.
update_install_permission_message: Please allow Fushi to install apps in system settings, then retry.
update_install_restart_windows_hint: If the listed processes are closed but libmpv-2.dll is still locked, restart Windows and install again.
update_mac_install_incomplete_message: The update could not be applied, so Fushi is still on the previous version. You can retry the update, or download the latest release manually.
updates_center_empty_hint: Subscribed anime, manga chapters, extension and app releases show up here.
updates_extension_auto_update_hint: On launch, install newer versions of manga and video extensions whose signature hasn't changed. If online sources were already opened, it waits until the next launch.
updates_history_clear_confirm_body: Remove all entries under "$scope"? Updates that are still pending, such as a newer app version you have not installed, will show up again on the next check.
updates_notify_anime_extension_hint: Alert when an installed video extension has a newer version in its repository.
updates_notify_app_release_hint: Alert when a newer Fushi release is available.
updates_notify_manga_chapter_hint: Check followed online manga for new chapters in the background.
updates_notify_manga_extension_hint: Alert when an installed extension has a newer version in its repository.
updates_notify_video_episode_hint: Alert when a subscribed series finishes downloading a new episode, or a show in your video library gets new episodes.
updates_system_notifications_hint: Also send a system notification. Turning this off keeps the in-app badge.
updates_video_library_auto_update: Auto-add new episodes to the video library
updates_video_library_auto_update_hint: Every few hours while Fushi is open, check online-source shows and media-server series you added to the video library for new episodes and add them. Whether you get notified is controlled by the new-episode notification switch.
usage_stats_enabled_hint: Once a day, sends an install ID (derived from this device, unchanged after reinstalling), the app version, platform, update channel, app language, CPU architecture, OS major version and install source (e.g. app store or installer) to fushi.moe so we can count active users. No account, library or reading data is included, and your IP address is not stored — only the country or region it resolves to is kept. When you attach device info to feedback, the install ID is sent with it.
video_acquisition_media_server_unconfigu: No media servers yet. Add Jellyfin, Emby or Plex in settings.
video_acquisition_online_source_unconfig: No Aniyomi sources enabled. Install an extension to search online sources.
video_acquisition_torrent_unconfigured: No BT sources for this title yet. Add a BT source to search for resources.
video_ajatt_enabled_hint: Off means the AJATT archive is skipped when searching subtitles.
video_ajatt_settings_hint: Free Japanese subtitle archive (kitsunekko mirror). No account needed; subtitle files download from GitHub.
video_anidb_hash_hint: Requires an AniDB account and a registered client. Uploads only file size and hash. AniDB UDP login is unencrypted; enable only on a trusted network.
video_anidb_http_api_unregistered: Not registered (only UDP hash identification and offline titles are available)
video_anidb_login_test_client_update: AniDB login succeeded, but AniDB reports a newer version of client $client
video_anidb_login_test_failed_auth: AniDB rejected the username or password
video_anidb_login_test_failed_backoff: AniDB has not answered several requests in a row; backing off, try again shortly
video_anidb_login_test_failed_blocked: AniDB is rate limiting or under maintenance; requests are paused for now
video_anidb_login_test_failed_client: AniDB rejected the client name/version (unregistered, outdated or banned)
video_anidb_login_test_failed_network: AniDB UDP connection failed: check UDP port 9000 and the firewall; an HTTP proxy cannot carry UDP
video_anidb_login_test_hint: Sends one UDP login with the saved account and client, then logs out. No file is hashed.
video_anidb_login_test_incomplete: Not tested: fill in the username, password and a registered client name/version first
video_anilist_error_api_disabled: AniList has temporarily disabled its public API because of server-side stability problems. This is not a problem with your network or proxy - the request reached AniList and was refused. Please try again later.
video_anilist_error_rate_limited: AniList is rate-limiting this app right now. Wait a moment and retry.
video_anilist_error_unreachable: Cannot reach AniList (graphql.anilist.co). Check your network connection, or configure a proxy in download settings.
video_audio_track_fallback_muxed: The audio stream was refused; switched to a compatible stream with sound (lower quality)
video_audio_track_load_failed: Couldn't load the audio stream — there is no sound. The source refused access; try again later.
video_bluray_config_invalid: The Blu-ray playback configuration is invalid. Replace KEYDB.cfg with a valid file and retry.
video_bluray_config_missing: Blu-ray playback requires a matching KEYDB.cfg configuration.
video_bluray_config_network: Could not download the Blu-ray playback configuration. Check your connection and retry.
video_bluray_config_no_match: No matching playback configuration was found for this disc. Provide an updated KEYDB.cfg and retry.
video_bluray_protection_unsupported: This disc uses an unsupported protection format. AACS 1 with a matching playback configuration is supported.
video_bluray_stream_corrupt: This Blu-ray stream is damaged: ${name} cannot be read at byte ${offset}. The disc or its copy is bad (for example a read error filled with zeros); the playback configuration is not at fault. Clean or re-rip the disc and retry.
video_bluray_stream_encrypted: This Blu-ray stream is still AACS-encrypted. Fushi does not decrypt protected discs, so it can only play unencrypted BDMV folders or video files.
video_bluray_stream_undecryptable: Could not decrypt ${name} at byte ${offset}: the KEYDB.cfg key does not match this disc, or the data is damaged. Check KEYDB.cfg first; if other titles on this disc play, the copy is likely damaged.
video_bottom_next_cue: Next subtitle (forward a bit if none)
video_bottom_prev_cue: Previous subtitle (back a bit if none)
video_clip_export_remote_download_requir: Download the remote video to this device before exporting a clip
video_clip_export_share_unavailable: Clip saved, but the share sheet didn't open: ${path}
video_clip_export_source_changed: Video source changed; clip export cancelled
video_collection_no_local_member: No local video in this collection
video_control_customize_hint: Choose where each button sits on the player, or move it out.
video_control_immersive_layout_hint: After locking, only these buttons stay on screen. They appear when you tap the picture and work in every immersive level.
video_control_palette_hint: Drag a button into a slot to add it; a button can sit in several slots.
video_control_reject_immersive_lock: The lock button is the only way out of immersive mode and must stay.
video_control_reject_required: Required controls must stay on the player.
video_control_reject_unavailable: This control cannot be placed there.
video_control_reject_volume_bottom: Volume can only sit on the bottom bar.
video_cover_online_hint: Search the metadata provider by title, or switch to ID. Picking a result only uses its cover; the work's identity is not changed.
video_cover_online_no_image: This result has no cover image. Try another one.
video_danmaku_manual_bind_empty: No danmaku for this episode yet.
video_danmaku_manual_bind_failed: Couldn't load danmaku for this episode. Try again later.
video_danmaku_manual_bind_server_error: The danmaku server rejected the request. Try again later.
video_danmaku_manual_network_error: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
video_danmaku_manual_search_prompt: Search Dandanplay by anime title, then pick an episode.
video_disc_angle_extraction_unavailable: This menu-selected angle cannot be extracted. Switch to the main angle before creating cards.
video_disc_audio_selection_pending: Wait for the disc to select an audio track, or choose one before creating cards.
video_disc_chapters_menu_unavailable: Chapters are available once the main title is playing; the disc menu has no timeline.
video_disc_extraction_unavailable: This title plays through the disc decoder, but its encrypted source cannot be extracted for subtitles or cards.
video_disc_menu_open_failed: This disc's menu could not be opened. You can still play its titles directly.
video_disc_menu_unavailable_missing_bdj: This disc's menu is BD-J, and this build does not include the BD-J components.
video_disc_menu_unavailable_mobile_bdj: This disc's menu is BD-J, which this platform does not support.
video_disc_menu_unavailable_remote: This disc is on another device, so its menu cannot open here. Download it to this device to use the menu.
video_disc_menu_unavailable_remote_dvd_f: This DVD is a VIDEO_TS folder on the other device; menus stream only from ISO images. Download it to this device to use the menu.
video_disc_menu_unavailable_remote_host_: The paired device runs an older Fushi that can't share disc menus. Update it, or download the disc to this device.
video_disc_menu_unavailable_remote_runti: This device's player can't read discs over the network yet. Download the disc to this device to use its menu.
video_disc_menu_unsupported: This player does not support Blu-ray menus. Update the bundled player or open a title directly.
video_disc_navigation_failed: The disc could not complete this menu action.
video_disc_open_on_host_failed: Couldn't open the disc on the computer
video_disc_open_on_host_sent: Opened the disc menu on the computer
video_disc_remote_buffering_hint: This disc keeps buffering over the network. Download it to this device for smooth playback.
video_disc_remote_download_unsupported: The paired device runs an older Fushi that can't share whole discs
video_disc_runtime_description: This disc uses a Java menu. Download about 40 MB of components for Fushi. The installation is private to Fushi and does not change your system Java.
video_disc_runtime_install_failed: Could not install the components. Check the connection and retry.
video_disc_runtime_required: This disc needs the Java menu components. Retry to install them, or play a title directly.
video_disc_title_binding_failed: The selected title could not be linked to the library. Learning features are paused.
video_discovery_anidb_identity_confirm_h: AniDB has more than one possible match. Pick the right work and the imported download will scrape with that identity directly; skip and you can assign it later from the pending list.
video_discovery_anidb_identity_not_found: Could not identify this work on AniDB. It will download normally and wait in the pending list for manual identification.
video_discovery_cancel_downloads_body: $n download task(s) for this title will be stopped. Downloaded pieces stay on disk; you can start the download again later.
video_discovery_cancel_downloads_failed: Could not cancel the download. The task may have already finished, or the download backend is unavailable.
video_discovery_manual_identity_hint: Enter the title, external ID and year above to enable search
video_discovery_pipeline_idle: Not downloaded → Download → Organize → Subtitles → Scrape → Library
video_discovery_provider_failed: Some sources failed temporarily; showing the rest
video_discovery_provider_rate_limited: Some sources are rate limited; showing the rest
video_discovery_provider_warning: Some providers are unavailable. Showing available results.
video_dolby_vision_colors_unsupported: Dolby Vision profile 5 video: this platform can't render its colors correctly yet, so the picture may look purple or green.
video_download_path_mapping_invalid: Enter a profile ID, remote root, and absolute local root.
video_download_path_mappings_hint: Map each qBittorrent remote root to a locally accessible folder.
video_download_target_source_empty: No locally accessible video source is available. Add one on the Sources tab first.
video_download_target_source_hint: New downloads are organized into this local video source.
video_drop_audio_unsupported: Drop subtitle files onto the current video. Audio files cannot be attached here.
video_drop_subtitle_only: Drop subtitle files onto the current video.
video_external_categories_invalid: Categories must be comma-separated numeric IDs.
video_external_endpoint_invalid: Enter a valid endpoint without credentials, query parameters, or fragments.
video_external_insecure_http_hint: Use only for a trusted local network endpoint.
video_external_save_error: The configuration could not be saved. Check the highlighted fields.
video_file_error_content: Unable to load the video file. Please ensure this file exists and is located in a directory accessible by the application.
video_filter_series_standalone_empty_hin: No standalone videos. Videos in collections are on the Series tab, or set the Series filter to All.
video_google_lens_disclosure_body: Recognizing text in this video sends a reduced JPEG copy of the paused frame (including image subtitles) to Google. The endpoint is unofficial and may stop working. Nothing is uploaded unless you agree.
video_google_lens_disclosure_title: Send video frames to Google Lens?
video_import_folder_as_source_hint: Keep scanning this folder for new videos
video_import_stream_url_hint: Play HLS/m3u8/mp4 stream URL (with optional external subtitle URL and anti-leech Referer/User-Agent)
video_import_subtitle_optional: Optional external subtitle (you can switch between embedded/external subtitles anytime during playback)
video_iptv_import_hint: Each channel is added as a stream and grouped into collections by group-title. An HLS stream playlist is imported as a single video.
video_iptv_list_empty: No channels found in this list.
video_item_rescrape_not_planned: This video isn't in any local video source's scrape plan
video_jimaku_api_key_hint: Get a free API key at jimaku.cc/account
video_jimaku_api_key_settings_hint: Also editable in Settings → Video → Subtitles
video_jimaku_enabled_hint: Off means Jimaku is skipped even when an API key is saved.
video_jimaku_episode_unlabeled: No subtitle labeled episode $episode; $count unlabeled files may still match
video_jimaku_no_key: Enter your Jimaku API key first
video_jimaku_scope_hint: Japanese subtitles for anime and Japanese live-action titles. A free API key is required.
video_jimaku_series_lookup_degraded: Couldn't confirm the series on AniList this time, so these results come from a plain title search and may mix in other seasons of the same series.
video_jimaku_source_failed: Could not check subtitle availability. Try searching again.
video_jimaku_source_hint: Choose one Jimaku entry. Season packs are matched by episode automatically.
video_library_delete_rows_failed: Could not delete $n video(s); they are still in the library.
video_library_empty_source_hint: Add a video folder from Sources to build your library
video_library_filter_empty: No videos match the current filters.
video_library_scrape_auto_backfill_hint: Entering the video library scrapes entries that still have no confirmed identity. Turn off to stop all background metadata downloads.
video_load_failed_network: Network error - check your connection and try again.
video_load_failed_not_found: This item was not found in your library.
video_load_failed_not_opened: The player couldn't open this video. The file may be in use, or the video engine needs the app restarted.
video_load_failed_timeout: Connection timed out - the network is slow or the source is rate-limiting. Please try again.
video_load_failed_unavailable: Couldn't get the video stream - it may be unavailable, region or age restricted, or the source changed.
video_mark_remote_failed: Couldn't mark $n item(s) on the server.
video_mark_server_failed: Couldn't update the server for $n item(s). Local state was updated.
video_mark_watched_through: Mark this and earlier as watched
video_media_server_launch_unavailable: This media server is no longer signed in. Sign in again in Settings › Services, then try again.
video_metadata_download_staff_images_hin: Save cast/staff profile photos locally while scraping (up to 10 per work). Off: photos load from TMDB on demand.
video_metadata_identifier_words_hint: Rewrite, block or offset titles before they are matched
video_metadata_identifier_words_syntax: One rule per line, # starts a comment. Block: a regular expression. Replace: A => B. Episode offset: front <> back >> EP+1. Combined: A => B && front <> back >> EP+1.
video_metadata_image_limit_hint: 0 = unlimited. Best-rated images are kept in the order: metadata language, original language, English, textless.
video_metadata_primary_provider_hint: The other source is used as a fallback when the primary source has no exact match or is unavailable.
video_mine_overwrite_cancelled_no_target: Saved card not found; overwrite cancelled
video_mining_audio_source_fallback_cente: Center channel extraction failed; sentence audio used the playing track
Couldn't confirm a center channel; sentence audio used the playing track
video_mining_audio_source_fallback_no_ce: This audio has no center channel (not 5.1/7.1); sentence audio used the playing track
video_mining_audio_source_fallback_track: No audio track $n here; sentence audio used the playing track
video_mining_audio_source_hint: Where video cards take sentence audio from. If the choice isn't available for a video, the playing track is used and you're told.
video_mining_image_mode_video_clip_inlin: Picture and sentence audio are saved as one clip, so they always stay in sync. WebM plays inside the card (auto-plays when the card is shown; tap the sentence to replay); MP4 opens in Anki's own player.
video_mining_still_format_hint: Encoding used when the card image is a still screenshot. JPG is much smaller; PNG is lossless but several times larger. Animated covers are unaffected — they follow the animation format setting.
video_ocr_frame_web_unsupported: On-screen text recognition isn't available for site videos
video_online_extension_unavailable: The video source extension for this episode is not installed or is disabled. Reinstall or enable it in Browse › Extensions.
video_online_library_added: Added $n episodes to the video library
video_online_mining_mode_background_hint: The popup marks the card as added right away and keeps the video going; the clip is prepared and sent to Anki in the background.
video_online_mining_mode_deferred_hint: Cards are prepared in the background and kept in a list; they go to Anki when you leave the player or tap Add all. Remove any you don't want first.
video_online_mining_mode_wait_hint: The popup waits until the card is in Anki, so you can still edit the latest card.
video_online_services_setup_description: Optional accounts and API keys can improve video identification and subtitle search. Basic playback works without them.
video_online_sources_empty: No enabled video sources. Install and enable an extension first.
video_online_sources_hint: Third-party Aniyomi extensions (extensions-lib 14). Content comes from each extension's website and plays in the built-in player.
video_online_stream_none: This episode returned no playable stream.
video_opensubtitles_app_key_hint: Leave blank to use the bundled app API key.
video_opensubtitles_languages_hint: Comma-separated language codes, for example zh-CN,en,ja
video_opensubtitles_settings_hint: API credentials are never exported in backups; they may sync to paired devices over Interconnect (can be turned off in Interconnect settings).
video_quality_auto_lowered: Network is slow — quality lowered to $label
video_quality_empty: No switchable quality for this video
video_quality_enhancement_hint: Turn this on to sharpen the picture with mpv's built-in high-quality scaling. Works for anime as well as live-action shows and movies. To go further with shaders like Anime4K, open Image enhancement while a video is playing and pick a level there.
video_quality_load_failed: Couldn't load qualities for this video.
video_quality_separated_audio_refused: YouTube refused the separate audio stream of this video, so other qualities are unavailable.
video_remote_close_video_confirm: Close the video playing on the computer? Its position is saved.
video_remote_control_editor_hint: Drag buttons between the main controls and more buttons. Play/pause always stays.
video_remote_error_action_unsupported: Fushi on the computer doesn't support this yet. Update it and try again
video_remote_error_certificate_mismatch: The computer's certificate doesn't match the paired one; pair again
video_remote_error_controller_busy: Another device is controlling this video
video_remote_error_controller_lease_lost: Remote control timed out or was taken over; reconnecting
video_remote_error_favorite_ambiguous: Several subtitle lines match this favorite
video_remote_error_favorite_source_unava: The video for this favorite is no longer available
video_remote_error_favorite_subtitle_mis: This favorite's subtitle line was not found in the video
video_remote_error_host_busy: The computer can't switch videos right now. Close the dialog on it and try again
video_remote_error_internal_error: Something went wrong on the computer
video_remote_error_invalid_request: The computer rejected the request (${code}); update Fushi on both devices
video_remote_error_lookup_expired: The lookup expired; tap the sentence again
video_remote_error_mining_busy: The computer is still creating the previous card
video_remote_error_mining_failed: Card creation failed on the computer
video_remote_error_no_video: No video is open on the computer
video_remote_error_pairing_rejected: The computer rejected this device's pairing; pair again
video_remote_error_remote_closed: Remote control was closed on the computer
video_remote_error_requests_busy: The computer is busy; try again shortly
video_remote_error_subtitle_busy: Subtitles are still loading on the computer. Try again shortly
video_remote_error_subtitle_candidate_mi: These search results expired; search again
video_remote_error_subtitle_search_faile: The subtitle sources didn't respond; try again later
video_remote_error_subtitle_source_missi: No online subtitle source is set up on the computer (Settings → Video → Subtitles)
video_remote_error_subtitle_track_unavai: That subtitle track can't be selected
video_remote_error_subtitles_changed: Subtitles on the computer changed; refreshing
video_remote_error_task_missing: The card task was not found on the computer
video_remote_error_video_extraction_unav: The computer couldn't extract audio or images for the card
video_remote_error_video_missing: This video is no longer in the computer's library
video_remote_favorites_empty_hint: Long-press a subtitle line to save it here.
video_remote_library_empty: The computer's video library is empty
video_remote_open_favorite: Open this favorite on the computer?
video_remote_overwrite_pending: Still mining on the computer. Overwrite later.
video_remote_subtitle_refetch_none: The server has no text subtitles for this video
video_remote_subtitle_search_applied: Subtitle downloaded and applied on the computer
video_remote_touchpad_caret: Choosing a word on the computer
video_remote_touchpad_caret_entry: Hold: choose a word on the computer
video_remote_touchpad_caret_hint: Drag: move · Tap: look up / confirm · Hold: long press in the card · Two-finger tap: back
video_remote_touchpad_caret_unavailable: No subtitle on the computer screen to choose from
video_remote_touchpad_hint: Tap: play / pause · Double-tap: replay line · Swipe left / right: next / previous line · Swipe up / down: volume
video_remote_unsupported: This device does not support video remote control
video_remote_waiting: Waiting for a video on the computer
video_resource_missing_message: The file for 『$title』 could not be found. Its location may have changed, or the drive may not be connected. You can re-import it, or remove this entry.
video_resource_source_skipped: ${name}: not searched (this source can't handle the query)
video_scrape_ai_searched: Searched again with titles suggested by AI
video_scrape_collection_rename_body: The matched entry has a different name. Renaming is optional: the cover and details are saved either way, and a rename also replaces the old name on your other synced devices.
video_scrape_diagnostic_confirm_body: The package includes relative file and folder names, scrape summaries, and original NFO contents. It does not add videos, subtitles, images, absolute paths, app configuration, or app credentials. Original NFO files are preserved unchanged and may contain personal information or secrets; review the package before sharing publicly.
video_scrape_pending_ai_unassigned: No AI provider assigned to video identification
video_scrape_pending_cause_hash_conflict: File hashes point to different works
video_scrape_pending_record_missing: No reason in recent scrape runs
video_scrape_tmdb_key_empty: Save a TMDB API key, then press Search. Results from other sources are not shown here.
video_screenshot_clipboard_unsupported: Copying images to the clipboard is not supported on this platform
video_secondary_subtitle_copy_empty: No secondary subtitle line to copy
video_setting_auto_scrape_hint: Automatically identify and fetch video metadata after library scans
video_setting_av_delay_float: Adjust over the video (keeps subtitles visible)
video_setting_av_delay_hint: Positive = subtitle later (cues pushed back); negative = subtitle earlier. Use the slider, +/- buttons, or type a value.
video_setting_brightness_swipe_gesture_h: Swipe up/down on the left half of the video to change screen brightness. Turn off to use the system brightness slider instead
video_setting_clip_export_video_bitrate_: 0 = follow the source (the stream is copied when possible); any other value re-encodes the video at that bitrate
video_setting_danmaku_area_hint: Fraction of the screen height danmaku may occupy, from the top.
video_setting_danmaku_block_rules_hint: One rule per line. Wrap a line in slashes like /pattern/ for a regular expression; otherwise it matches as case-insensitive text.
video_setting_danmaku_enabled_hint: Render local or matched danmaku over the video without blocking controls.
video_setting_danmaku_manual_match_hint: Search Dandanplay by title and pick the episode when auto match fails or is wrong.
video_setting_danmaku_max_active_hint: Caps comments rendered per frame to keep large files responsive.
video_setting_danmaku_online_hint: When no usable local sidecar exists, match the opened video with Dandanplay and fetch related comments.
video_setting_danmaku_speed_hint: Higher is faster; scrolling danmaku cross the screen sooner.
video_setting_disc_auto_fullscreen_hint: Desktop only. Leaving the disc restores the previous window size, position and maximized state.
video_setting_disc_open_menu_by_default_: When off, the play button starts the main title directly.
video_setting_double_tap_hint: Double-tap the left or right of the video to seek
video_setting_double_tap_toggles_playbac: On touch screens, double-tapping the middle of the video (or anywhere when double-tap seek is off) toggles playback
video_setting_drag_seek_sensitivity_hint: How far one full-width swipe seeks on a touch screen: Low about 45s, Medium about 90s, High about 180s. Independent of the video's total length. Touch drag only; mouse and keyboard seeking are unaffected.
video_setting_hdr_compute_peak_hint: Measure each frame's real peak brightness instead of trusting the stream metadata. Better highlights, costs some GPU.
video_setting_hdr_output_mode_hint: Windows only. Auto outputs HDR when the display is in HDR mode and the video is HDR; Always outputs every video as HDR / 10-bit; Off always shows SDR (HDR videos are tone-mapped). Video and interface are composited together either way.
video_setting_hdr_tone_mapping_hint: Curve used when an HDR source has to be squeezed onto an SDR display. Auto lets mpv pick per source.
video_setting_immersive_mode_hint: Controls what remains available after pressing the side lock button
video_setting_immersive_tap_reveal_hint: While locked in immersive mode with subtitles blurred or hidden, tap anywhere on the picture to show the current line; it hides again when the line changes
video_setting_jimaku_default_language_hi: Defaults to the video's own language (audio track / scraped metadata). Pick one to always prefer that language instead.
video_setting_jump_pill_auto_hide_hint: After a seek, hide the "back to previous position" pill after this long; it reappears on the next jump
video_setting_long_press_speed_hint: Temporarily use this speed while holding the video.
video_setting_mpv_lua_scripts_empty: No scripts in the mpv_scripts folder yet
video_setting_mpv_lua_scripts_import_hin: Every .lua file in the mpv_scripts folder loads when a video plays. Deleting a script takes effect the next time you open a video.
video_setting_mpv_lua_scripts_input_note: Keyboard and mouse input stays in the app and never reaches mpv: scripts that rely on key bindings or the OSC cannot be triggered. Scripts driven by properties/events and OSD messages work.
video_setting_mpv_lua_scripts_status_pen: Not loaded in this playback (reopen the video)
video_setting_mpv_lua_scripts_unavailabl: The bundled libmpv on this platform was built without Lua (-Dlua=disabled), so scripts cannot run here.
video_setting_mpv_passthrough_hint: Send AC-3, E-AC-3, TrueHD and DTS-HD untouched to your receiver or soundbar so it decodes them (Atmos included). Only turn on if that device supports these formats — otherwise there may be no sound. While passing through, set the volume on the receiver: Fushi's volume and mute can't act on these streams, so at any speed other than 1×, below full volume or when muted, Fushi decodes them itself for the time being (the receiver's Atmos / DTS indicator goes off). When off, Fushi always decodes them and 5.1 / 7.1 still play as surround.
video_setting_mpv_raw: Extra mpv options (one per line, key=value)
video_setting_mpv_raw_hint: Desktop only; options that cannot apply at runtime (e.g. vo, profile) are ignored. SVP/RIFE need external tools and are not supported.
video_setting_mpv_sigmoid_hint: Sigmoid-curve upscaling reduces ringing but costs GPU. Off by default for performance; turn on if you want sharper upscaling.
video_setting_mpv_volume_max_hint: Above 100% the player boosts the audio in software; very high values can distort
video_setting_pause_ocr_scope_hint: OCR the paused frame so its text can be tapped for lookup. Text subtitle tracks don't affect it.
video_setting_picture_fit_contain: Fit keep ratio add black bars
video_setting_picture_fit_hint: How the picture fills the player area
video_setting_qb_category_hint: Downloads pushed by Fushi get this category; completion tracking only watches it.
video_setting_qb_url_hint: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080. Leave empty to disable anime downloading.
video_setting_screenshot_destination_hin: Where screenshots go: a save dialog, the clipboard, or straight into a folder
video_setting_screenshot_directory_hint: Where screenshots land when the destination is Save to folder
video_setting_secondary_av_delay_hint: Adjust the secondary subtitle offset independently. It follows the primary offset until set here.
video_setting_secondary_subtitle_obscure: Blur or hide the secondary (translation) subtitle
Secondary: reveal when paused or hovered
Same as the primary subtitle switch, but for the secondary (translation) subtitle. Turn it off to keep the translation obscured even while the primary subtitle is revealed.
video_setting_shortcuts_hint: View and customize the player's keyboard and gamepad shortcuts
video_setting_slim_progress_bar: Slim progress bar at the bottom
video_setting_slim_progress_bar_hint: When the controls fade out, keep a thin accent-coloured progress line along the very bottom of the video. In the mini window it is always shown, since the full seek bar is hidden there.
video_setting_subtitle_auto_upload_to_ho: When playing a video from a connected host, subtitles you import or retime are uploaded and set as that episode's default for every device. Turn off to keep them on this device only.
video_setting_subtitle_backfill_hint: When a scrape finishes, videos that still have no subtitle get one from your configured online sources. Never replaces an existing subtitle.
video_setting_subtitle_font_hint: Font for subtitles, with a live Japanese preview
video_setting_subtitle_obscure_hint: Choose how subtitles are obscured for listening practice: off, blurred (hover or tap to reveal), or hidden.
video_setting_subtitle_obscure_reveal: Primary: reveal when paused or hovered
video_setting_subtitle_obscure_reveal_hi: While the primary subtitle is blurred or hidden, pausing, looking a word up, hovering (desktop) or tapping it reveals it temporarily. Turn this off to keep it obscured no matter what.
video_setting_subtitle_reference_sync_hi: Retime downloaded subtitles to the video's embedded subtitle tracks. Applied only when the evidence is strong; otherwise the file is left as-is.
video_setting_subtitle_respect_ass_hint: Use the font, color, and outline built into .ass subtitles when available; turn off to force your appearance settings.
video_setting_tap_toggles_playback_hint: Turn off so tapping the video only reveals the controls
video_setting_theme_song_auto_skip_hint: When an OP or ED recognized from your music library starts, jump straight to its end
video_setting_tmdb_key_hint: Optional. Leave empty to use the built-in key. Fill in your own only if scraping stops working or you want to use your own quota.
video_setting_torrent_limit_lan_hint: Off by default: transfers with peers on your local network ignore the limits above.
video_setting_torrent_memory_hint: Cap engine memory. 0 = auto (based on device RAM).
video_setting_torrent_seed_ratio_lifetim: Stop uploading once uploaded/downloaded reaches this — counted over the torrent's whole lifetime, including uploads while it is still downloading (downloading continues). 0 = unlimited.
video_setting_torrent_seed_time_hint: Stop uploading after seeding this long. 0 = unlimited.
video_setting_torrent_upload_enabled_hin: Off by default. Seed back to the swarm after downloading.
video_setting_volume_swipe_gesture_hint: Swipe up/down on the right half of the video to change volume. Turn off to use the physical volume buttons instead
video_settings_cat_controls_hint: Arrange on-screen buttons and custom actions.
video_settings_cat_picture_hint: Decoding, scaling quality, HDR, geometry and color. Changes apply instantly.
video_settings_cat_shaders_hint: Sharpen and upscale with GPU shaders such as Anime4K. Higher tiers need a stronger GPU.
video_settings_cat_subtitle_hint: Tracks, timing and appearance. The preview follows your style changes live.
video_settings_summary: Playback, picture, subtitles, controls and library
video_shader_anime4k_hint: Pick a preset to download. After downloading, tick it in the list to enable. Desktop only.
video_shader_first_use_body: For sharper anime playback, open Image enhancement and click Download Anime4K presets. It downloads recommended shaders, then you can tick the installed ones to enable them.
video_shader_import_from_mpv_hint: Search local mpv automatically, or choose an mpv folder when none is found.
video_shader_mobile_perf_hint: On phones, Medium/High/Ultra use deblur-only Anime4K chains: the upscaling passes are left out, because your screen is no larger than the source, so they would cost a lot of GPU for little gain and slow the whole app down. Results still vary by device GPU, and shaders only apply on the standard GPU render path — drop a tier if you see dropped frames or heat.
video_shader_mpv_dir_empty: No shaders found in that folder
video_shader_preset_mode_a_fast: For most 1080p anime. Lighter GPU load.
video_shader_preset_mode_a_hq: Highest quality for 1080p anime. Needs a strong GPU.
video_shader_preset_mode_b_fast: For older 720p anime with resampling artifacts.
video_shader_preset_mode_b_hq: High quality for older 720p anime with resampling artifacts. Needs a strong GPU.
video_shader_preset_mode_c_fast: For old SD (480p) anime with compression smearing.
video_shader_preset_mode_c_hq: High quality for old SD (480p) anime with compression smearing. Needs a strong GPU.
video_shader_tier_custom_hint: Custom shader selection. Pick a tier above to switch to a preset.
video_shader_tier_high_hint: Anime4K HQ. Sharper; best for animation, also usable on live-action (smaller gain). Needs an upper-mid GPU (NVIDIA RTX 4060 / RTX 3070, AMD RX 6700 XT / RX 7700 XT).
video_shader_tier_high_hint_mobile: Anime4K deblur (M) at the source resolution. Larger kernel than Medium; still no upscaling passes. For faster phone GPUs.
video_shader_tier_low_hint: mpv built-in sharpening (ewa_lanczossharp). Works on any video (animation and live-action). No download, lowest GPU load. Pick this on integrated or older cards (NVIDIA GTX 1050, AMD RX 560, Intel iGPU).
video_shader_tier_low_hint_mobile: mpv's built-in sharpening (spline36 on phones). No download, no extra GPU passes. The safe choice if anything above this drops frames.
video_shader_tier_medium_hint: Anime4K Fast. Best for animation, but also works on live-action movies/TV (smaller gain). Runs on mid-range GPUs (NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 3050, AMD RX 6600).
video_shader_tier_medium_hint_mobile: Anime4K deblur (S) at the source resolution. No upscaling passes, so the cost does not scale with your screen. Start here on phones.
video_shader_tier_off_hint: No enhancement. Plays the original video as-is.
video_shader_tier_ultra_hint: Anime4K Mode A, VL + an extra deblur/denoise restore pass — the strongest reconstruction the video renderer can actually run: the High-tier VL chain plus one more restore pass for compressed sources. Also usable on live-action (smaller gain). Best on a strong GPU (NVIDIA RTX 5090, AMD RX 7900 XTX); pick a lower tier if yours is weaker.
video_shader_tier_ultra_hint_mobile: Anime4K deblur (M) plus an extra soft restore pass, both at the source resolution. Strongest phone tier; still no upscaling. Drop a tier if it drops frames.
video_source_grouping_change_hint: The next scan uses this setting. Existing collections and metadata are kept.
video_source_grouping_folder_hint: Create one collection per first-level subfolder. Files directly in the selected folder share a collection. Metadata scraping is unavailable in this mode; switch to By work to scrape.
video_source_grouping_series_hint: Recognize works and episodes from filenames, then match metadata.
video_source_restore_grouping_confirm: Series you dissolved will be grouped again by file name, the same way a fresh scan groups them. Collections you made yourself are not changed.
video_source_scrape_anidb_client_hint: Fushi includes a registered app client. Leave this blank normally; set a custom registered client only if needed.
video_source_scrape_anidb_client_version: Only custom clients need their own registered version here. Fushi maintains the default app identity; your personal AniDB login is still required.
video_source_scrape_auto_after_scan_hint: Run metadata scraping automatically after this source is scanned
video_source_scrape_background_hint: Tasks continue when this window is closed.
video_source_scrape_background_started: Scraping is running in the background
video_source_scrape_clear_all_busy: A video scan or scrape is still running. Try again after it finishes.
video_source_scrape_clear_all_completed: All video scrape records have been cleared.
video_source_scrape_clear_all_completed_: Scrape records were cleared. Modified or unverifiable sidecar files were kept.
video_source_scrape_clear_all_confirm_bo: This removes all scraped metadata and source bindings, clears the Series results, and deletes unmodified covers and NFO files generated by Fushi. Video files, library entries, groups, watch progress, subtitles, tags, manually selected covers, and user-modified sidecars are kept. This cannot be undone.
video_source_scrape_clear_all_failed: Could not clear all scrape records. No unverified user files were deleted.
video_source_scrape_clear_all_hint: Remove all video scrape metadata and Fushi-generated covers and NFO files.
video_source_scrape_clear_all_in_progres: A scrape-record cleanup is already in progress.
video_source_scrape_confirmation_hint: Multiple exact matches were found. Choose the correct work to save its provider binding.
video_source_scrape_enabled_toggle_hint: When off, manual, post-scan, post-download and background scraping all skip this source.
video_source_scrape_external_overwrite_c: This batch may replace third-party NFO/images or Fushi files you edited. Media files are not changed. Continue?
video_source_scrape_external_overwrite_h: Third-party or user-modified files remain protected until you confirm each manual scrape batch again.
video_source_scrape_list_load_failed: Could not load this list. Try again.
video_source_scrape_locale_follow_ui: Leave empty to follow the interface language
video_source_scrape_locale_hint: Preferred language for TMDB fallback and supplementary details. MAL uses the titles and text supplied by MAL.
video_source_scrape_manual_ambiguous: Several works have this title. Open the pending works tab and select the specific item to match.
video_source_scrape_manual_id_invalid: Enter a positive work ID or an official URL matching the selected source and type.
video_source_scrape_manual_query_hint: Search by title, or select MAL / TMDB movie / TMDB TV and enter an ID or official URL. Select a result to apply it to the current work.
video_source_scrape_manual_search_hint: Search the metadata provider by title, then pick the correct work.
video_source_scrape_metadata_locale_hint: BCP-47 language tag such as ja or zh-CN. Leave empty to follow the global metadata language.
video_source_scrape_pending_works_hint: These entries have no confirmed identity yet. Search and pick the right work to scrape them.
video_source_scrape_provider_policy: MAL (via Jikan) is the primary metadata source; TMDB is the fallback.
video_source_scrape_report_pending_backl: $n works in the pending list still need your confirmation.
video_source_scrape_report_summary: Done: $applied applied, $review awaiting confirmation in this batch, $failed failed; $protected protected files left untouched
video_source_scrape_run_no_issues: No warnings or errors were recorded.
video_source_scrape_work_missing: This work is no longer in the current source plan (its files may have been renamed, moved or deleted). Rescrape the source to refresh the pending list.
video_stream_protocol_unsupported_apple: This stream protocol (rtsps / rtmps / rtmpe) isn't supported on iOS or macOS yet.
video_strm_target_local: This .strm file points to a local file path, which isn't supported. Put the video file in a source library directly.
video_strm_target_unsupported: This .strm file has no playable stream address (http, https, rtsp, …).
video_subdl_api_key_hint: Get a free API key at subdl.com/panel/api
video_subdl_enabled_hint: Off means SubDL is skipped even when an API key is saved.
video_subdl_settings_hint: Subtitles in English and many other languages for movies and TV, matched by IMDb / TMDB id. A free API key is required; downloads count toward an anonymous daily limit per IP.
video_subtitle_ai_consent_body: AI proofreading sends only the Japanese text recognized from the audio, plus this work's glossary, to the provider assigned to "Subtitle proofreading" in Settings › Models › LLM. Audio and video frames are never sent. Requests are billed by that provider; local Ollama / LM Studio stays on this device. Results are not guaranteed and depend on the model.
video_subtitle_ai_entry_hint: Speech recognition + optional AI proofreading, saved next to the video
video_subtitle_ai_episode_exported_asr: A subtitle with that name exists; saved ${name}
video_subtitle_ai_episode_skipped_no_dia: Skipped: almost no dialogue (song or clip)
video_subtitle_ai_episode_skipped_song: Skipped: judged to be a song (OP/ED, MV)
video_subtitle_ai_error_reply_incomplete: the AI reply was incomplete after several retries
video_subtitle_ai_model_missing: The Japanese speech model for videos is not downloaded
video_subtitle_ai_moss_backend_hint: Auto uses CUDA on supported NVIDIA cards (Windows) or Vulkan (Linux)
video_subtitle_ai_moss_code_cuda_unavail: no NVIDIA GPU / driver that meets the CUDA requirement (driver R580+, RTX 20 series or newer)
video_subtitle_ai_moss_code_model_missin: the MOSS model is not downloaded
video_subtitle_ai_moss_code_no_runtime_f: there is no audio.cpp build for this backend on this platform
video_subtitle_ai_moss_code_runtime_miss: the audio.cpp runtime is not downloaded
video_subtitle_ai_moss_code_unsupported_: only available on Windows and Linux (x64)
video_subtitle_ai_moss_delete_confirm: Delete the MOSS runtime and model (${size}, all backends)? They will be downloaded again the next time MOSS is used.
video_subtitle_ai_no_local_episodes: No local video file to process
video_subtitle_ai_no_provider: No AI provider is assigned to "Subtitle proofreading"
video_subtitle_ai_nothing_to_rerun: No episode has been proofread yet
video_subtitle_ai_proofread_hint: Fix names and misrecognitions with AI (off by default)
video_subtitle_ai_remote_episode_unsuppo: Generating on the host only works for the first episode of a host playlist
video_subtitle_ai_remote_proofread_hint: Uses the AI provider assigned to "Subtitle proofreading" on the host
video_subtitle_ai_remote_result_missing: The host finished without returning subtitles
video_subtitle_ai_remote_segmenter_hint: Whether MOSS can be used depends on the host's GPU
video_subtitle_ai_remote_unreachable: Can't reach the host this video is on
